title: Keep Skeleton Alive! Demo
description: Vampires, Necromancer, Skeleton and even a Time Traveler. This Visual Novel has it all. But most important question is, can you actually keep Skeleton alive? I guess we will find out.

title: WishBreaker Alpha Test Demo
description: A genre-fusion ARPG. Every class plays differently, Warrior plays as Hack n' Slash, Rogue as Stealth rougelike, Cleric is decision based, Druids play creature collecting/farming, Wizards are puzzles, secrets, and code casting and many more! PVE and PVP including Bullet Hell and Soulslike areas!

title: The Mohist Demo
description: Play the first five stages of The Mohist. Build walls and ditches, deploy defenders and Mohist mechanisms, and face ladders, rams, escalade, siege towers, catapults, and earthworks. Includes a six-wave randomized challenge.

title: Ɐ L∞P Demo
description: A first-person observation horror game set in an apartment trapped in a ten-day loop. Find and correct every anomaly, survive the monster, and reach the door on Day 10. Miss one detail—or get caught—and you return to Day 0.

title: Skyreap Demo
description: Explore a forgotten archipelago of floating islands. Gather resources, build and automate production, and link islands into a thriving trade network, until the sky belongs to you.

title: 念 Horizon Demo
description: 《念》是一款以现代都市为背景的悬疑剧情恐怖游戏。故事发生在2025年的一个虚构现代城市中，玩家扮演的私家侦探张文勋突然收到一封匿名报案信件，随着信中线索调查，原本毫无关系的三起疑案诡异地联系起来……

title: Sword & Soil Demo
description: Every crop you sell, fish you catch, and monster you loot via real-time combat buys the gear for progression. Pick one of four classes and experience all of Chapter 1 in this free demo. Your save carries into the full game!

title: APEX: Black Monday Demo
description: Free demo of a turn-based Wall Street trading sim, played at a 1985 terminal. Trade and short through Two Weeks to Black Monday, earn your book in Act I of the campaign, and race the whole world on the Daily Tape. The full game adds the decade-long war against APEX Holdings.

title: QUIET Demo
description: A co-op, physics-driven burglary game about an alien crew stranded in the suburbs after a crash. Steal the parts you need to rebuild your ship. Work together, stay quiet, and watch out for the homeowners who aren’t exactly human.

title: Kiminoseidayo Demo
description: Try the first three stages of Kiminoseidayo, a 2-4 player online co-op platformer where everyone controls one character together. Split movement, jumping, and the camera, survive shifting roles, and turn spectacular teamwork failures into your next attempt.

title: 她的下一页 Demo
description: A cozy sticker game about finding your place after graduation. Arrange little objects to build street corners, a rented room, and a dream garden full of cats. Follow a young woman's next chapter, one sticker and one small kindness at a time.

title: Jester's Dungeon Demo
description: An Obscure Dungeon Crawler where you a wizard, Dives into a dungeon to reclaim your stolen Toy from a wicked Jester. Sacrifice your blood to the Black Eye and use it's powers to survive, slay monsters and master the dungeon .

title: Lords of Pain Demo
description: Lead a party of adventurers who explore and fight on their own in this fantasy auto-battler RPG. Shape their builds, craft equipment, manage supplies, and climb 40 floors to unlock the weekly challenge.

title: She Only Visits at Night Demo
description: A quiet, atmospheric slice-of-life narrative inspired by SCP-134. Work the graveyard shift at a lonely convenience store and form a gentle connection with a strange girl who only visits after dark. Fulfill her small requests, watch the store change, and find comfort in the quiet night.

title: SCP: Darkwater Demo
description: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

title: Barbless Demo
description: The first chapter of Barbless. You sold everything you owned and bought a house on a tidal coast, sight unseen, to learn to fish. Here every fish is a boss fight: read the tell, answer right, and it tires. Answer wrong and your line snaps. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: Elderwood Online Demo
description: Dive back into the golden age of MMORPGs. Leveling is the journey, not a sprint: every level is earned, builds take real thought, and the world grows wider, never taller. No auto-play, no shortcuts to endgame, no pay-to-win. Made by a solo indie developer for those who love the long climb.

title: Trial by Mana Demo
description: Level up, learn new spells, loot unique equipment, slay hordes of enemies, and conquer mighty foes in this action-packed Bullet Heaven Rogue-lite!

title: Greaselord Demo
description: Build the biggest fast food empire in the world and defend it against three rival chains before the health authorities ban you. Your goal: 80% of the world market across 169 countries, with one of 14 main dishes.

title: POLYFAULT Demo
description: Top-down arena shooter on a DOS kernel. Farm geometric polyfaults, allocate cycles into your chassis, load a new image, and clear a 10-minute field against three bosses. Panic. Reboot. Rank CYC.

title: Hammer of the Gods Classic Demo
description: Strive to become Odin's chosen in this classic 4X strategy game, using a combat system later popularized by Heroes of Might and Magic. The Norse gods play a direct role in this game, guiding players to raid coastal cities, attack monasteries, conquer cities and build a mythic Viking empire.

title: Eidolophone MELODY エイドロフォン～旋律～ Demo
After Troy Demo
description: After Troy is a turn-based deckbuilding game set in Greek mythology. Explore a hex map, fight enemies, recruit companions and capture cities. Each card has multiple uses. Build your deck with new actions, spells and relics, and combine their effects.

title: Superposition VR Demo
description: Night security at the Plant. Nobody clocks out. Hold the yard against armed intruders until your shift ends, alone, in the rain. A free standalone night shift from Superposition VR, the roguelike shooter in Early Access.

title: Booker Blitz Demo
description: Book the chaos. Call the shots. Booker Blitz is a keyboard-first wrestling promotion management sim with Gorilla Position live match control — audibles, run-ins, and finishes you change mid-match. Build the card, cut the promos, sign the deals, and run the show.

title: Tactical Squad Demo
description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player operation, then settle the score in PvP.

title: Last Stream Demo
description: Demo of Last Stream, a 1–4 player online co-op horror game. Go live inside Grandpa's house, solve the puzzles hidden in his memories and keep your chat watching. But every clue you bring back makes him angrier. Run. Hide. Keep recording.

title: Scrap Horizon Demo
description: Scratch it clean. Sell it high. Don't break it. Send drones to salvage scrap and carefully scratch away dust, rust, and oil. Sell your finds, upgrade your tools, and grow your workshop up to the first Prestige. Your demo save file carries over to the full game!

title: Phobopetra Demo
description: A Soul, A Story, A Stone. 1962 Antarctica. An expedition unearths a stone that shatters reality. Trapped in a shifting 1960s estate, you must use its unnatural light to reveal hidden secrets. Time is bleeding away in this cinematic mystery. Can you escape before the heartbeat stops?

title: Paradox Demo
description: One player hunts. Four players run and fight back with superpowers. Use unique abilities, complete objectives, and escape through ancient Egypt, Victorian London, and more, to complete the the story.

title: THANK YOU FOR YOUR TAXES Demo
A Cultivator's Death Demo
description: This demo contains Act 1 of A Cultivator's Death. It involves a few hours of gameplay, as well as every aspect of the game and 4 bosses. The full game will consist of three Acts.---Do you ever wonder how YOU would fare if Earth was suddenly overrun by monsters? This is your chance to find out!

title: KISI: The Deja Vu Demo
description: 〈기시: 더 데자뷰 (KISI : The Deja Vu)〉는 광기 어린 실험장소에서 느껴지는 기묘한 위화감, 즉 ‘기시감(Déjà Vu)’을 소재로 한 3D 이변 찾기 심리 호러 어드벤처 게임입니다.

title: Intercept Line Demo
description: You command Ukraine's air defense. Every night — missiles and drone swarms, and always fewer interceptors than targets. By day it's your turn: deep strikes past enemy radars. And when orders aren't enough — take the stick yourself.

title: Moonlight Demo
description: Moonlight is a survival crafting game set in a dynamic alien world that shifts around you. Change the landscape of a beautiful, deadly, procedurally-generated 2D world by growing food, encountering strange creatures and building powerful machines that will help you escape this awful place... maybe.

title: Marimomo Demo
description: Virtual pets, WITHOUT the responsibility! Collect cute marimo moss balls and care for them on your schedule. They will always stay alive for you! Switch to Desktop Pet Mode and your Momos will keep you company on any digital space (including livestreams!) There’s a multitude of moss to amass!

title: The apartment case Demo
description: Inspired by Malaysian culture and folklore, the game follows Lim Ming, a supernatural investigator tasked with uncovering whether the apartment hotel is truly haunted and the evil within.

title: Idle Mage: Conquest Demo
description: An idle incremental RPG about a mage fighting through escalating waves. Wield powerful magic, face powerful bosses, and Ascend for permanent power. Optimize your build, watch the carnage unfold, and keep conquering while you're away

title: The Staring Man | 凝視男 Demo
description: A first-person horror game set in a Japanese convenience store. You work the night shift alone. Across the street, a man stands staring at you every night. As you encounter inexplicable events, you investigate the mystery of a former employee who disappeared.

title: MALMORT Demo
description: A first-person tower defense set in the Louisiana bayou, 1850. The dead are rising from the black water. Choose one of four heroes, build traps and turrets on stilted walkways, and fight the horde yourself to protect the last totem holding back the evil. Solo or 2-player co-op.

title: Gravity Miner Demo
description: A PS1-style first-person mining roguelite inside a floating cube of a million blocks. Shift gravity to walk on any wall, dig for ore before your oxygen runs out, dodge buried bombs and hatching monsters.

title: Side Shop Simulator Demo
description: A cozy idle shop-sim that can sit in the corner of your screen while you work or play. Stock products, upgrade your tools, and expand your business comfortably from your desktop!

title: 三更夜后 Demo
description: Gather rumors and clues by day, then plan your route through a changing ancient city after dark. Investigate an unpaid-wages case that leads to missing grain, a disappearance, and concealed evidence. You cannot help everyone—and every decision leaves a consequence. Simplified Chinese only.

title: THE NOM MUST BE FED Demo
Domain-Controller Demo
description: One morning shift on the Kelmore helpdesk. Unlock an account in PowerShell, check a PC over Quick Assist, walk to a desk to fix the Wi-Fi, then go down to B5, where cell block B's alarm keeps going off and one of the subjects is watching you work.

title: Bean in a Ball Pit Demo
description: Try Bean in a Ball Pit for free. Wade into a colorful physics playground, hunt for hidden beans, and turn cleared balls into cash for vacuums, conveyors, cannons, and bots. The demo includes the Easy and Medium pits with one save slot.

title: I am the Dungeon Boss Demo
description: Descend a cursed dungeon where every victory leaves a scar. Dethrone the boss, and your legend rises as the next guardian — an echo that waits in the dark. Roguelike permadeath, shifting floors, and optional ranked play against other players’ legacies.

title: Motorbike Dealer Simulator Demo
description: Run your own motorbike dealership in the heart of the city. Order bikes and riding gear, stock your showroom, set prices and haggle with buyers at the counter. Grow from a small garage into the city's top dealer with licenses, expansions and staff.

title: CC: Bianca's Sigils Demo
description: CC: Bianca Shuffle is a compact and stylish color‑placement puzzle game built around the many outfits of Bianca. Arrange the correct Bianca variants onto each colored square, progressing through 120 handcrafted logic challenges that steadily increase in complexity.

title: SoulPurge Demo
description: SoulPurge is a psychological horror mystery. Explore an old abandoned mansion. Find clues to solve the mystery. Discover how and why its former inhabitants lost their lives. Evade the horrors that wander the mansion halls. Free their tortured souls in an attempt to redeem yours.

title: Falling Demo
description: In Falling, guide your ball through obstacle courses in free fall. One touch is all it takes to start over. Easy to pick up, tough to master — and create your own levels.

title: Lethal Geometry Demo
description: The free demo of Lethal Geometry: the Training sector, Relay and Crossfire, up to Intensity 3. Build a machine of mirrors, splitters and lenses, watch the light tire in every enemy it burns, and grab a mirror when the wave slips past.

title: MeowMiner Demo
description: Dive into the charming clicker world with an adorable cat miner! Smash rocks, mine gold, unlock new pickaxes and endless depths!

title: 再跑亿遍 Demo
description: 《再跑亿遍》以2D横版建造模拟为核心玩法。这里没有投机取巧的捷径，你将在性格各异的代码娘的帮助下通过建构代码框亲手重构破碎地形，敲定启动指令，目送承载希望的小车驶向终点。 在一次次尝试、修正、重启中，突破种种困难。这是属于程序员的极致浪漫，也是修复世界的唯一法则。 我们的领航员在第110次试错中消耗了519MB内存在73秒内通过了第95个挑战，欢迎各位玩家前来参与讨论。本企划仍在开发制作中，目前的游戏呈现并非最终品质。后续还会有更多代码娘加入修复世界的团队之中，不同的“仿生体”间会摩擦出什么样的火花？我们的“领航者”将会邂逅哪些代码娘，又会碰到什么样的困难？敬请期待吧！

title: TALLREAPER Demo
description: A seemingly simple task given to you by the Baron, turns into living hell, revealing a dark, surreal and introspective story, as you - a prisoner - are tasked with obtaining a fallen knights sword inside an underground crypt.

title: Notary Block Demo
description: The watchman is dead — the knife is still out. A co-op suspense accusation horror in a Hong Kong estate rebuilt from a real twin-tower block. Four to eight players, one hidden killer. Vote at the meeting, or take the watchman's keys. You only left if you walked through the gate yourself.

title: The Pond Demo
description: Lovecraft horror merging puzzle game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

title: popwork 职场爆爆乐 Demo
description: PopWork is a lightweight roguelite about popping bubbles on an endlessly regenerating bubble wrap. A tribute to the classic Ten Drops: chain-detonate with cross-shockwaves, earn coins, buy items, grab snacks, learn tips, adapt to random events and stage effects, and spend every bubble wisely.

title: ROTORORA Drone Racing Demo
description: The shortest route is not always the fastest! Try two colorful courses in this 8-drone racing demo. Climb, dive, take boost detours and battle with missiles, rapid fire and barriers. Race CPU rivals or play online using your Steam account.

title: Ranch Attack: Farmer on the Run Demo
description: The goats are back and they have hired a bull. Grab, hurl, and outrun the herd in this updated version of Ranch Attack Classic: a fast, funny 3D arcade runner with two farmers, a barn full of unlockables, and the original prototype as a bonus.

title: Puzzles Are Better Together Demo
description: Try the free demo of Puzzles Are Better Together, a cozy 3D jigsaw game for solo play and online co-op. Relax with calming music and satisfying piece placement, then wishlist the full game to follow its release.

title: Hero of the Sealed Labyrinth Demo
description: Explore floors B1–B10 in this demo of Hero of the Sealed Labyrinth, a single-player RPG with auto-battles, loot, and character growth. Support your hero with click attacks, upgrade equipment, and unlock sword skills and magic.

title: Puzzle Simulator Demo
description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

title: Pizzeria: The Pizza Restaurant Sim Demo
description: Build your own pizzeria from scratch! Roll the dough, slice the toppings, cook your sauce in a pot, bake the pizza in the oven and serve your customers. Tweak your recipes, furnish your restaurant, manage your money and become the neighborhood's favorite pizzeria.

title: Factopia Demo
description: Factopia is a factory automation game where every item you produce feeds a growing city. Design efficient production chains, then supply the schools, hospitals, police, and fire stations that keep your citizens alive and thriving.

title: Robo Dream Party Demo
description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler set inside a robot's dream, where physics goes haywire. Punch, grab, and throw anything you find, ride robot vehicles, and knock your friends off the map to be the last robot standing!

title: Spin Realm: The Sovereign's Doom Demo
description: An exploration roguelite where everything is decided on a wheel. Chase gear that bends your luck, take the fights you think you can win, and end the Sovereign's tyranny. Die and the city takes you back. Play alone or with friends.

title: My Dirty Little Lake Demo
description: Cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back in this cozy, relaxing game. With cute dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear. Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house. Wildlife appreciates your work.

title: Burnout Runs Demo
description: A drag racing roguelite. Build your car from parts that bend the rules, beat the bosses of the coast and save the garage that raised you. 125 cars, a 100-level pass and a full livery editor.

title: Hungry Ghosts Demo
description: Hungry Ghosts is a wild tower defense roguelike where you exorcise hungry ghosts with magical desserts and drinks! Play as a fearless witch and her various companions with unique powers, upgrade your dishes, and unleash powerful synergies to survive haunted waves and defeat bosses.

title: JEEP HORROR Demo
description: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

title: Anomaly Cafe Demo
description: Manage a quaint coffee shop hidden deep in an unknown forest. Brew daily cups for ordinary travelers, but be prepared to adapt your service when unusual and anomalous entities start lining up for their caffeine fix.

title: Vermin God Demo
description: A grotesque body horror visual novel inspired by SCP-027, play as the young host of the Vermin God. Wake up in a hidden lab with no memories and experience the terror of a mysterious disease turning your body into a living hive for swarms of pests. Make choices to escape the crawling chaos.

title: ISO/2004 Demo
description: ISO/2004 is a grounded psychological horror game about guilt, trauma, and disturbing memories rotting inside a decaying provincial home. Step into a suffocating, atmospheric nightmare where raw emotional tension slowly warps reality. Face what you left behind before the shadows consume you.

title: Anomalous Coffee Machine 3 Demo
description: You're a broke freelance artist who just found a reality-bending coffee machine in your apartment stairwell. Discover anomalous drinks, dominate social media, sell your anomalous creations online, and spread the weirdness.

title: BACKROOMS: PRIMAL Demo
description: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

title: ASWANG HUNTER Demo
description: Real-time horror battler meets tense house defense. As a rogue hunter, explore vulnerable homes, watch window silhouettes, and protect families from an Aswang outbreak. Scavenge bolos and spears, manage controls for each arm, and stop folklore monsters from escaping. Will they survive until dawn?

title: Sort Memes Together Demo
description: A meme store has exploded! Grab, stack and throw 80 meme products with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sort every cat loaf, stonks bust and pet rock onto the right shelf, and turn total brainrot chaos into the tidiest meme shop on the internet.

title: Sabado Demo
description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

title: Dulat Demo
description: Dulat is a puzzle-platformer where you manipulate how you interact with matter to overcome obstacles and restart the universe. Embark on this adventure, unravel its mysteries, and discover the secrets behind a broken world.

title: Flippin Broke Demo
description: Evicted, broke, and all you've got is a stupid bottle. Flip it, raid Crusty Carl's bin for weirder bottles, and build a team where every bottle has its own chaotic trait. Kick the curb and flip it till you’re rich!

title: Orbital Peril Demo
description: What happens to you when your mobility is completely left to the wind?  Use only two keys to control your weapon direction in a 360 degree orbit while danger envelops you!  In this realm, you will definitely die, but what kind of impression will you leave before you take your very last breath?

title: Way Too Many Fish! Demo
description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw way too many species of fish into the right crates.

title: Huanhai: A Career in Ink Demo
AL-Mafia Demo
description: Try AL-Mafia offline against bots. Press "-" to spawn bots and test hidden roles, night actions, voting, eliminations, maps, and the core gameplay before the full online multiplayer release.

title: Count on Chaos Demo
description: Help Buddy fight through the first three zones of the Wallpaper Kingdom. Give a plain answer to strike and brace, or build an equivalent equation to hit harder. Face SPOOL, SWITCH and LEECH while viruses throw pop-ups, steal keys and play dirty.

title: Console Repair Simulator Demo
description: Play the first three days of Console Repair Simulator. Open your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street, sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then unscrew, diagnose and repair them on the repair mat. The demo ends with the Game Saloon's grand opening.

title: Aftermyth Demo
description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

title: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket Demo
description: Free demo: tear open Winky chocolate bars, rewrap them as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell them. Hire workers, runners and couriers, knock through the first wall and play ping-pong or air hockey on your break, alone or with up to three friends. The full game goes on to 1 Billion.

title: I Am Train Demo
description: A cozy train track builder, demo version of I Am Train. Drive your train around the world picking up passengers from various platforms. Build houses and towns to connect passengers.

title: Ant Clicker Demo
description: Grow a living ant colony in this free incremental idle demo. Click or hold to gather, recruit six ant castes and watch your underground nest expand. Play without a time limit, save your progress, and carry it into a new full-game colony on the same Steam account.

title: POPPER GIRL VS ZOMBIES Demo
description: Play the free demo of POPPER GIRL VS ZOMBIES, a pop-yet-dark retro PS1-style 3D zombie shooter! Blast through zombie swarms in an exclusive stage and try the real-time item management. If you enjoy it, please Wishlist the full game on the main store page!

title: Act Normal Demo
description: Act Normal is a multiplayer game where you blend in as an NPC and steal enough to survive each round. With scores hidden, you never know if you're safe. Every player carries a hidden gun. Find them before they find you.

title: Brick Builds Demo
description: Try the Brick Builds workbench. Snap, rotate and recolor pieces in a relaxed building sandbox. Learn with four guided kits, make a showcase model your own, or start from a blank mat and build whatever comes to mind.

title: Conduct Demo
description: Short demo of the opening levels of Conduct.

title: The Black Hole Is Hungry! Demo
Lost Ball: Homeward Bound Demo
description: One lost ball. One epic journey home. Bounce, roll and blast your way through a 3D world of colourful environments from gritty cityscapes to fantastical worlds. Master new abilities, overcome tricky obstacles and solve challenging puzzles along the way. Ready to roll? Then let’s bounce

title: Cosmic Seance Demo
description: A cosmic detective game. Summon the old gods. Ask. Interpret their visions. Trade your sanity for the truth, but the more you learn, the closer you come to madness.

title: Robits: Quantum Descent Demo
description: Bounce, dash, and ricochet in this momentum-driven roguelite twin-stick shooter set in a procedurally generated, living quantum arena that never lets you settle in. Stack weapons and mods into a drone built to survive it.

title: Warstead Demo
description: Try WARSTEAD in this early singleplayer demo: build a medieval settlement, manage production chains and care for your citizens. Play up to 45 active minutes per campaign, with saving and loading. Multiplayer is not available in the demo.

title: AGGRO: Thaumiel Mercenaries Demo
description: A sci-fi exploration third person shooter about anomalies hunting down and containing anomalies. Command a squad of powerful mercenaries, travel through strange and mysterious worlds, and fight monstrous foes to capture and research them!

title: Cindocu: The Omens Demo
description: Follow in the footsteps of Persia Kelborn - heir to the oldest dynasty on the continent of Ferrum. Uncover the dark secrets hidden within his family for centuries, and witness events that began long before he was born...

title: Crusaders of the Blessed League Demo
description: Build a party of adventurers and help them ascend into legendary heroes. Find exceptional loot, craft unique builds, discover powerful synergies, and lead your crusader party through increasingly dangerous battles in this deep fantasy autobattler.

title: Blue Collar'd Demo
description: A co-op physics-based construction building game. Manage resources, craft materials and build against the clock!

title: Archival Security Demo
description: The first three shifts of ARCHIVAL SECURITY. Roughly 30 to 45 minutes. A psychological horror game about a transcription job that goes wrong very slowly. Copy the slides, follow the six rules, and find out what the third one was protecting.

title: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket Demo
description: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES is a cozy single-player organizing simulator. Enjoy 45 minutes of relaxing gameplay as you sort scattered games and consoles, restore order to your video game store, and take your first steps toward rescuing your mischievous cat from the claw machine!

title: Cardfight: Conspiracy Demo
description: A story-rich RPG told from multiple perspectives. A fusion of turn-based card battling and quick-time defense. Six classmates, each with their own decks - and their own secrets. Your name is SPARTAN JACK, your new friends are part of a deadly secret society, and you have a conspiracy to uncover.

title: PAPERWORKS Demo
description: Shred paper, scan books, and burn humanity's knowledge for cash in this first-person incremental game. Upgrade your machines, automate the paperwork, and uncover the dark secrets behind an AI-driven future.

title: Magus Slayer Demo
description: Steal spells from defeated magi and choose the order they fire in. Pull enemies into a black hole, then erupt swords from its centre—or reverse the order for a different build. Return to the tavern to research new spell forms and prepare your next descent.

title: MERDAN: Night Protocol Demo
description: Try the opening cases of a night-shift investigation thriller. Question callers, connect evidence and decide where limited help goes when emergency calls and official records disagree.

title: Talaire Demo
description: Astronauts stranded on the moon have gone a little crazy. Race office chairs, complete repair mini-games, and sabotage your rivals to win the heart of the Luna: a rock with a wig. They're taking this very seriously.

title: RailBlaster Demo
description: Play all of Act 1: ride three worlds that pulse with the music, Short Fuse, Skimline and Overdrive, then face THE PYRE. Build combos, slow time and blast ghosts and blinkers. Play on a monitor or in VR, or with friends in local split-screen.

title: Kingdom.py Demo
description: The free demo of Kingdom.py, a town builder you play in real Python. Write the scripts your heroes run: build houses, farm, collect taxes, fight off bandits, serve merchant ships. The first 13 chapters of the story, from your first build() to a town that runs on loops.

title: Little Wasteland Diner Demo
description: Open a cozy little diner in a world recovering from the apocalypse! Grow and gather ingredients, cook homemade meals, and serve the townsfolk. Enjoy a heartwarming blend of farming, cooking, and restaurant management in this free demo.

title: blockia Demo
description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo. Free demo with selected parts.

title: CrossSpell Demo
description: Weave words together and create chains through intersections! This is a demo version of *CrossSpell*, a competitive crossword puzzle game. You can play modes such as CPU battles, local multiplayer, Deck Spell mode, and experimental online matches.

title: Astral Echelons Demo
description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter! This Demo shows off the first four levels of the full game plus the first bonus level.

title: Fragment Echoes Demo
description: A fast-paced sci-fi hack-and-slash roguelike where you wield four weapons, chain fluid air and ground combos, and evolve your combat style with randomized Echo abilities.

title: Riddled Together Demo
description: A first-person online co-op puzzle game where communication is the only way to solve puzzles and escape.

title: The Main Menu Demo
description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

title: After Eternity Demo
description: Awaken as the Inquisitor, prepare your soul, and dive into an epic sci-fi survival horror adventure. Fight ceaseless horrors, challenge abhorrent scientists, and protect the universe in its final moments. Will you ease humanity into a peaceful slumber or succumb to the dream of a new world?

title: Studio Zero Demo
description: 《Studio Zero》is a first-person cyberpunk FMV thriller. In a future ruled by megacorporations, every choice you make dictates your fate. Will you shatter the system, become a corporate puppet, or vanish into the neon night? Step in—your choices shape the ending.

title: Please Handle Gently Demo
description: Please Handle Gently is a pixel-art autobattler card game. Late at night, sit down at the counter for a while — pick out a few figurines, give them a little magic back. A whole cabinet of jingling little things. They're old. Please handle gently.

title: Crimson Spine Demo
description: A Metroidvania set in a dark fantasy world where Raed, a knight resurrected under mysterious circumstances, uses her new heart as a weapon to recover her lost memories.

title: Card Warrior Demo
description: Card Warrior is a wuxia roguelike card game combining martial arts and card mechanics. Play cards to strike, parry, counterattack, and strike relentlessly when you spot enemies’ flaws. Walk the path of a worrior. What kind of hero will you be?

title: From The Top: Chimera Overdrive Demo
description: Y2K Action Roguelike where you fight through battling top tournament to (eventually) buy yourself a house. Collect new parts, Chimera together spinning tops and Overdrive to victory, starting From The Top!

title: Rockblaze Demo
description: Dark times have fallen upon AXIOM DYNAMIC. HELLCORE, the system designed to predict the future, is destroying itself from within, generating an ever-increasing number of SYSTEM CONFLICTS. To bring the situation under control, the DIGITAL PATROL was created.

title: PDR Simulator: Paintless Dent Repair Demo
Slime Splitter Demo
description: A pixel art incremental game about popping slimes. Sweep your jelly ring across the arena and split every slime into smaller pieces until the screen overflows, then spend the jelly on a huge skill tree and card deck to push past 15 bosses and into endless mode.

title: Eternal Spectre Demo
description: Play a free demo of Eternal Spectre, a cinematic third-person RPG set in a world fractured by time. Combine gauntlet powers and abilities and follow Unit 56 operative Jared through combat and story scenes on Arias Island.

title: Beat Metro Demo
description: 지하철에서 마주치는 다양한 승객들의 리듬에 맞춰 입력하며 이야기를 진행하는 리듬 게임. 익숙한 출퇴근길 풍경 속, 저마다 다른 사람들의 리듬과 작은 이야기를 만나보세요.

title: Iron Grave : Planet 9 Demo
description: Iron Grave: Planet 9 is a sci-fi mech survivor game. Pilot multiple mechs with unique skills and evolution, slaughter enemies, unlock upgrades. Set on the ninth planet over a century from now, fight alongside your squad and become a hero.

title: Fleshwalk: An Experience Demo
description: A transformational and reflective first-person horror experience from the face of Lichen Labs.

title: Hammer and Hoard Demo
description: A 3D tower defense game about smashing piggy banks, collecting coins, and paying the next bill. Build roaming hammers and ranged towers, choose cards and skills, and adapt as enemy routes change. Every target that slips through takes its reward with it.

title: Mom! I'm gonna be a black hole when I grow up! Demo
Wurzzle Demo
description: Wurzzle is a fast-paced word strategy puzzle where you build words, maximize letter values, and use powerful board bonuses to chase high scores. Play the single-player demo and discover a fresh twist on classic wordplay.
developer: Block By Block Publishing, Universal Phoenix Group

title: VIZZA Demo
description: VIZZA turns simulations into living scenes. Poke a pattern, tune its behavior and colors, record a favorite moment, or keep it moving as your wallpaper.

title: Stick Life: The Daily Grind Demo
Twinblocks Demo
description: Easy to Learn. Hard to Master.TwinBlocks is a falling-block puzzle game with roguelite elements, powerful card upgrades and handcrafted worlds.Build massive combos, complete missions and use your items wisely. Choose from randomized card upgrades during each run and combine their effects to shape your strategy.

title: A Rover's Journey Demo
description: A Rover's Journey is a 3D, narrative, exploration game, set in space! Play as Roo-ver, and help your astronaut companion discover all the lunar landscape has to offer. Traverse difficult terrain, avoid crashing meteors, and uncover tech from previous expeditions. Can the moon can sustain human life?

title: They’ll Hang You for That Face
The Berliner Demo
description: The Berliner is your quintessential bakery and cafe simulator set in 1980s west Berlin. You can explore the walled city, bake pastries, brew coffee, serve and deal with customers. Grow your business or spend it all at the bar its up to you. And don’t forget this is Berlin! Don't let your guard down.

title: 究極の選択の勇者の伝説 体験版
Fire Isle Demo
description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

title: PropAlive Demo
description: PropAlive is a tense 1v4 asymmetrical PROPHUNT game where one player becomes an ancient demon, while the others are survivors who can disguise themselves as objects and use unique abilities. Hide. Trick. Survive. Or Hunt.

title: 좀비 프린세스 Demo
description: Raise a daughter infected with a zombie virus in this dark fantasy raising simulation. Over 5 years, balance your daily care in secret with dangerous expeditions. Will you cure her humanity, or help her rise as an immortal zombie queen? Discover over 60 unique endings!

title: VoxMancer Demo
description: Speak your spells in VoxMancer Demo, a voice-driven 3D magic PvP game. Learn the basics in the tutorial, practice spellcasting, and challenge other players online. A microphone is required. This demo is in active development.

title: SLINGHOOK Demo
description: Fire your slinghook and fly. Tap to yank yourself toward any hook point, hold to swing, and chain it all without touching the ground. Race through eight photoreal landscapes as fast as you can. No enemies, no combat, just speed.

title: Crown Cribbage Demo
description: The cribbage night you remember. Two, three and four-hand play: online at tables, passed around one screen at home, or against distinct opponents who never peek at your cards. Watch them play each other while you chat, or train in The Study — your first fifteen to muggins.

title: Inner City Unit Demo
description: Inner City Unit is a first person immersive sim about the narcotics trade in the surveillance city-state of Annexia. As an agent of an intelligence outfit, assume the identity of Albert Buchanan - part-time writer, part-time narcotics dealer. Procure product, push it across the city, don't get made.

title: China Youth Academy Demo
description: Live three formative years as a young footballer, or manage U13, U16 and U19 squads in a struggling academy. Train, compete, negotiate and face the consequences of your choices in a darkly comic take on youth football, where the hardest challenges often happen off the pitch.

title: Bat Flapper Demo
description: Fly as a bat through pitch-black caves where Echo-Location reveals danger. Eat glowing bugs to keep your passive sonar alive, dodge deadly obstacles, and chase high scores in a tense 3D arcade runner.

title: TowerOf100Heroes Demo
description: Free demo of Tower of 100 Heroes. Mow down endless hordes in this auto-attack survivors-like roguelite and free the heroes sealed in the Witch's orb. Climb the first 30 floors across 3 regions, defeat 6 bosses, unlock 30 heroes, awaken skills and farm Diablo-style loot.

title: Sirens Demo
description: The demo features a section of the first level of the game- Nordic Island.

title: FAT HOBO: Hobocop Saves Christmas Demo
description: Fat Hobo is a first-person RPG adventure game about an ex-cop, turned vagrant hunting a killer. Convince, steal and whizz your way to the bottom of an unbelievable mystery.

title: Spell Cage Demo
description: Spell Cage condenses hack-and-slash combat and deep buildcrafting into short roguelite runs. Fight through randomized dungeons without quests or complex navigation, and experiment with a wide range of builds.

title: Bellna & Repp's FUTAstic Adventure Demo
description: Futanari + Cute Girls + Action-Adventure + Gimmick-filled Dungeons in a semi-open world! Search for untold treasures in this lively, exciting, and risqué adventure!

title: Skull Crusher Demo
description: SKULL CRUSHER is a retro/PSX-style round-based survival FPS. Face endless waves of skeletons, earn money to open new paths and upgrade your arsenal, and stay standing for as long as you can. Become the terror other skeletons fear.

title: Nordic Demo
description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player.  Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends! Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

title: Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites) - Final Cut Demo
description: Step into a terrifying world of atmospheric horror fully remade for PC displays. Investigate dark supernatural mysteries, uncover hidden evidence, and wield powerful sacred relics to survive relentless malevolent forces in Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites).

title: Veil of Time Demo
description: Play the prologue and Chapter 1 of Veil of Time. Take a bounty with Gill, get the family sword from your uncle, and follow your missing brother's trail into Castra Forest. Real-time sword fights with parries, turn-based party battles, and your save carries into the full game.

title: SUNSTONE: A Tale of the Briar King Demo
description: Play the opening of SUNSTONE in its orbital 3/4 view. Leave the village of Sunhome, walk a sunlit 8-bit country seen in 3D, and brave the first tomb, THE HOLLOW, and the guardian who holds it. One tomb of nine, and the whole country, free.

title: Bush League Baseball Demo
description: Play ball at The Palace. One free exhibition, the Mudcats at the Regents, in full 3D with bobblehead ballplayers, a royal grandstand and Chuck Baseball in the booth, delighted by every error. Real rules, terrible players, three to nine innings.

title: Hysterical Strength Demo
description: A boogeywoman driven by vengeance explores a decrepit world, cutting down the warlords in her way. With an ancient blade, a magical top-break revolver, and the perfect combo of drugs, survive or live in this 2.5D hack-and-slash FPS hybrid adventure.

title: Towerburst Demo
description: An incremental tower defense game where you fight enemies using unique tower combinations. Gather resources from fallen enemies, unlock and upgrade your towers, discover new tower synergies and defeat every enemy before your towers run out of shots.

title: APARTMENT 001 Demo
description: You awaken inside an unknown facility and must explore its mysterious spaces in order to recover your lost memories. Gather clues, follow the records and procedures left behind by the Bureau, and overcome the threatening anomalies that stand in your way.

title: Endless Battle: Idle & Build Demo
description: Endless Battle：Idle & Build（无尽战斗：放置与构筑）是一款放置挂机刷宝游戏，8个技能，4个强化……丰富的装备效果构筑，与机制独特的助战伙伴 消灭每一层的敌人，不停攀登。挂机刷宝，直至——终焉之境！

title: Trenchblocks Demo
description: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

title: Limbival Demo
description: You went to a carnival for fun, but suddenly realized that you are the real source of entertainment! Luckily, you still have your limbs, so you can escape from here... right?

title: AuraFalls Demo
description: Try Aura Falls free. Roll around the island hub with up to three friends, survive waves of robots together, bowl a strike in a neon alley, and settle it one-on-one in the ring. Everything you earn carries over to the full game.

title: Chaos & Seek Demo
description: 3v3 multiplayer chaos: three invisible ghosts trash a house while three hunters track them by radar and suck them up with vacuums. You can't see the ghosts — only hear the crashing. Catch all three, or wreck the place before the three-minute clock runs out.

title: Luminote Mio: Aqualoom at Ocean's End Demo
description: A cozy narrative simulation game set in a quiet, post-apocalyptic world. Following the cast as they try to understand both the world around them and themselves. Design aquariums to share comfort for your newfound friends, explore what remains, and take the time to bond through sincere conversations.

title: Pyro Spice Demo
description: Fast Paced Third Person ShooterPlay as chili peppers in chaotic, highspeed combat. Dash, shoot, and reposition to stay alive, solo or with friends.Easy to Host and JoinHost your own game or jump into a friend’s match with the listen-server setup, quick to start, simple to join, chaos guaranteed.

title: Plucked Demo
description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

title: Quiet Time Demo
description: Experience the first two days of Quiet Time, an atmospheric survival crafting game where every sound matters. Explore, gather, craft, and use music to awaken the world, influence creatures, and survive.

title: Weavercraft Demo
description: Step into your great-aunt's old weaving house, brave the cold, and craft your first warm layers.

title: フロントライン×デッドライン Demo
LINE WARLORD Demo
description: A real-time line-battle roguelite. Spend rations to summon swordsmen, shields, archers and cavalry onto a single front, then break the enemy base. Pick relics and promotions at every fork to build a different army each run. Three commanders, three ultimates.

title: Sword of the Demiurge Demo
description: You have been bestowed the 'Sword of the Demiurge' and the authority to sever the bonds of soul and flesh. Make haste for your appointed time has arrived. Defeat your foes, collect their souls, and manifest your authority, until the myriads fall before you in a single moment.

title: Electronics Repair Shop Demo
description: Open your own electronics repair shop! Take devices apart, diagnose faults, and replace broken components. Buy and sell used electronics, invest your earnings in new equipment, and grow your small shop.

title: CLOG & ORDER Demo
description: Clog toilets or fix pipes in this chaotic online party battle for 2–6 players. Try the Student Dorm map, all eight base characters and a complete match through the final Boss fight. At least two players required; no bots or single-player mode.

title: Beyond The Roots Demo
description: Face the guardians of the sky. Beyond The Roots is a challenging 2D pixel art Boss Rush where every fight is a test of precision. Play as a determined human aiming to rise to the rank of gods and take down the fallen angels blocking your path.

title: Deadline 0:00 Demo
description: A fast-paced shooter where you need to be EXACTLY ON TIME. Estimate how long it'll take you to wipe out an entire floor of enemies, and deliver. Be careful - there isn't much room for error!

title: FallChess: Wizard's Chess Demo
description: Mount, move, and command chess pieces in a fully 3D duel. Choose your character, ride your piece across the board, and face your opponents up close. Capture pieces, outmaneuver your enemies, and experience chess like never before, brought to life in first-person action.

title: Arcane Circuit Demo
description: ARCANE CIRCUIT is a dark fantasy deck-building roguelite. Socket Core Cards into Emitters, chain Modules together, and create fully automated arcane circuits. Explore the wastelands, collect powerful Relics, and build your very own spell-slinging machine gun!

title: No Mercy Demo
description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

title: Everything We Brought Here Demo
description: A last-stand auto-battler on a dead magic world. Choose your heroes, upgrade their abilities, and try to hold on one more night.

title: SoloGami Demo
description: Fight tactical card duels across three rows and three rounds. Infect enemy cards with parasites, turn the weather into a weapon, and master the art of the well-timed pass. Every card hand-crafted, every duel a puzzle. Just you, the board, and one more match.

title: Woodturning Simulator Demo
description: Free demo: play the first week of Woodturning Simulator solo or with up to 3 friends. Sketch, saw, carve, paint and sell your first cute and silly figures from a big block of wood.

title: Rock Band Simulator Demo
description: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.

title: Metro Resonance Demo
description: An intense 30-minute first-person survival thriller set in a post-apocalyptic underground. Survive a pitch-black tunnel, gather spare parts to fix your handcar, and reach the sealing station before your gas mask filter runs out.

title: Mike goes on hike Demo
description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

title: Cloudwright Demo
description: Build a cozy factory in the clouds. Salvage your crashed airship, set conveyors humming across your home island, and build your first balloon. Play the opening chapter of Cloudwright solo or in online co-op, up to 8 players.

title: NOT Home Free Demo
description: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

title: TURBO Demo
description: Step into Turbo, an anime-inspired CRPG where your actions shape your journey. Explore a mysterious world, interact with characters, investigate your surroundings, and experience a glimpse of the story, systems, and choices awaiting you.

title: Time Collage: Focus Puzzle Demo
description: 只需专注 3 分钟，就能获得一块拼图。这笔买卖，挺划算吧？「Time Collage」就是这样一款围绕「即时反馈」设计的专注辅助游戏01 随机掉落的拼图碎片，会陪伴你度过每一次专注专注场景由左右两部分组成：左侧是拼图区，右侧是专注区。当你启动右侧的专注计时器，左侧的拼图区也会随之运转起来。每专注几分钟，都会有一块拼图碎片随机掉落。随着一次次专注完成，拼图也会将这段时间化作一片属于你的风景。小贴士：① 试试我们为你准备的待办、备忘录、计数器和正念等辅助工具？你可以自由调整它们的位置与大小，搭建属于自己的专注空间。② 你可以在设置中开启拼图自动排序与自动拼入。如果你不想花时间在拼图操作上，这会是一个轻松的选择。

title: Castellan of Aurelwatch Demo
description: Get an early look at Castellan of Aurelwatch! Explore a medieval fantasy world, fight enemies in turn-based combat, collect loot, and begin rebuilding a forgotten outpost.

title: Spectral Map Demo
description: movement based texture adventure with rpg elements.

title: MusicDamage
description: MusicDamage is a top-down multiplayer music shooter. Move, aim and fire to your weapon's rhythm in team battles and casual matches. Use cover and hazards, and enable optional fragment progression to collect rhythm fragments and upgrades that change how you play and build.

title: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners Demo
description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, then equip them with rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically at the edge of your desktop while you work or browse!

title: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ Demo
PROJECT M.E.D.S. Demo
description: The body is under attack. Hordes of infectious germs are spreading rapidly, overwhelming its natural defenses. As the last line of defense, you'll battle through massive waves of pathogens, unlock powerful medical weapons, and fight to keep your host alive.

title: Army Factory Demo
description: Build your settlement into a war machine. Gather resources, raise massive armies, prepare your regiments, and watch your battle plan unfold as thousands of soldiers clash.

title: The Last Hour of an Epic To the Moon RPG Demo
description: You like RPGs, but don't have the time to play it. We like RPGs, but don't have the time to make it. So here's the Last Hour of an Epic 1000-Hour To the Moon series RPG!

title: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles demo
description: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles is a male-oriented xianxia romance adventure game. Explore the martial world, meet unique female cultivators, grow stronger through cultivation, unlock character stories and intimate interactions, and embark on a journey of dual cultivation.

title: Hellmachina Railbane Demo
description: Demo of the Hellmachina Railbane game. It contain one unlocked realm & enough weapons to explore.

title: Stupid Tankers Demo
description: Play as “Ze Germans” in World War II: four friends, one tank, and a chaotic co-op adventure blasting your way to the front.

title: Masters of the Universe™: Legends Unite Demo
description: Unleash the power of Grayskull and experience Masters of the Universe™: Legends Unite firsthand in this demo that takes you deep into the heart of Eternia. In this cooperative deck builder, both heroes and villains come together as sworn enemies are forced into alliances.

title: Arborrosa Insidia Demo
description: Intro of game, that will give you to dive into atmosphere and get acquainted with the plot. Enjoy ;)

title: Just Weeding Demo
description: Pull weeds together with friends in this satisfying co-op cleanup simulator! Clear vast, overgrown fields with an addictive loop: weed, sell, and upgrade your gear. In this demo, jump in solo or online to experience the core mechanics and turn the wild terrain squeaky clean!

title: Cozy Sticker Home Demo
description: Decorate your dream home with over 500 adorable stickers! 🏡✨ Peel, place, and mix cute designs to create the coziest rooms filled with pillows, plants, pastries, and pure joy 💕🌿🧁✨

title: TRAUMATA Demo
description: TRAUMATA Demo - just a Clicker, no more! Click, click & click! ...and one more click! ...Or is it? The full game drops the casual facade and hits you with pure, unadulterated action on steroids!

title: Werewolf Hunter: Night of Horror Demo
description: Werewolf Hunter is a survival horror game about tracking a deadly predator in a hostile wilderness. Manage hunger and thirst, collect DNA to uncover its weakness, set traps, and barricade shelters. Hunt a regenerating beast that grows more dangerous with every night.

title: Make the World Great Again Demo
Party Bros Demo
description: Party Bros is a chaotic 2-8 player multiplayer party game! Gather your friends and compete in action-packed modes like combat, tag, and hide-and-seek.

title: E.G.O. Software Suite Demo
description: This is the DEMO license of E.G.O. Software Suite, a personal software suite created by Superego Inc.

title: Helltower Demo
description: A Roguelike RPG mixing spectacular action and rhythmic combat, in a dystopic hell where each soul has to accept their death, and the regrets that come with it.

title: Mind the Goo Demo
description: Defend one tower against waves of hungry slimes in a tower-defense roguelite. Draft Powerups, combine Charms, spend Gold in the shop, and unlock Workshop upgrades between runs. Try different builds and see how long your tower survives.

title: PaintScape Demo
description: Try PaintScape demo in single-player. Multiplayer, more maps, tools and character customization will be available in the full game.

title: Claimfall: ARPG Manager Demo
description: Inspired by Path of Exile, Claimfall distills the addictive depth of modern ARPGs into a loot-focused semi-idle management game. Customize skills, craft powerful items and make specialized builds for your characters. Explore the campaign and refine your strategy to conquer the endgame.

title: Noyan: Club Chairman Demo
description: In Noyan: Club Chairman, you’re the president, not the manager. Leave tactics to the coach; your job is to manage finances, lock down sponsors, and win over the fans. Remember: matches are played on the pitch, but the club’s future is won in the presidential office!

title: Things to Forget – Lighthouse Demo
description: James Miller, a 36-year-old lighthouse keeper, returns to work after a brief visit with his sister Olivia. Used to solitude, the sea and empty rooms, he senses the lighthouse feels different this time—and his routine shift is becoming something he never expected.

title: Second Stone Demo
description: Second Stone is a colorful Action RPG built around two fully playable parallel worlds. Play as Shiren, a young treasure hunter who can cross between the vibrant Light World and its sinister mirror, the Shrouded World. Master fast-paced combat and forge your path to power with elemental Manastones.

title: Never Be Alone Demo
description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

title: Londya Demo
description: Build your own combat styles in a single-player action RPG. Level up to unlock new attacks and evolve your styles as enemies learn your fighting patterns. Protect Londya on the road to the Lond, and adapt before your own habits become your downfall.

title: Reversi2048 Demo
description: A Reversi game where each piece’s score doubles every time it is flipped. Victory is decided by the total score of the pieces left on the board. Even if you have fewer pieces, flipping a single high-value piece could turn the game around. Simple to play, tense until the very end.

title: Who Pressed It?! Demo
description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

title: Fool's Trigger Demo
description: Welcome to the table where life is the stake. Fool’s Trigger is a tense mix of Russian roulette and a card game for 6. Load your revolver, manipulate the cards, put lives on the line, and dare to find out who will be the unluckiest today.

title: Helrift Demo
description: Experience old-school MMORPG intensity in Helrift, where two towns clash. Battle for dominance in server-wide events, master a classless stat and skill-based progression system, and engage in high-stakes open-world PvP. Forge your path through crafting, trading, and tactical combat.

title: shlack! Demo
description: Shlack! is a top-down roguelite where you play as an artist trapped inside their own magazine. Survive against your own characters and drawings.

title: Droste Detective Demo
description: You're stuck in an office corridor with no exit that has a painting of the same corridor on the wall. But then you notice the corridor in the painting is not quite the same. You decide to inspect the painting...

title: Tiny Ramen Shop Demo
description: 🍜 Run your own cozy Japanese ramen shop in this charming cooking simulator! 🐱 Prepare delicious ramen, serve hungry customers, and grow your restaurant with an adorable cat assistant. 🏮 But when night falls, mysterious yokai and spirits from Japanese folklore come looking for a warm meal! 👻

title: Socket Demo
description: A first-person psychological horror game where you play as a social worker who obeys a wall socket. Follow its instructions, explore the city’s last inhabited apartment building, and pry secrets from its residents. All to fulfill the terms of the contract.

title: Ecstatica Demo
description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

title: Stories Terminal Demo
description: Stories Terminal is a detective text adventure inspired by classic parser games. Type your own commands, explore pixel-art locations, collect evidence, and solve a murder case on a midnight university campus.

title: Ecstatica II Demo
description: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

title: Firefighters Code Red Demo
description: When fear takes over, your mission begins: in Firefighters Code Red you battle flames, smoke, and the clock!

title: Mow and Move Demo
description: Awaken as M-42, an autonomous mower in a quiet world buried beneath engineered grass. Mow vast fields, upgrade your machine, venture farther into the overgrowth, and uncover what humanity left behind. All at your own pace.

title: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor Demo
description: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

title: SecondPhase Hero Demo
description: Second Phase Hero is a Boss Rush action game where players step into the shoes of a hero embarking on a quest for revenge 20 years after that fateful night. Master an array of weapons and Ability to defeat formidable bosses, and unleash the SecondPhase within to reach new heights of strength!

title: PAYDIRT Demo
description: You got a job at a mining company. Sort of. Smash ore, dump it onto the pinboard to turn it into cash, then spend that cash to dig even more. Pay off your debt and you can clock out. Probably.

title: Void Keeper Demo
description: A roguelite of mining and base defense. Mine an asteroid field against the clock, haul the salvage home, and turn it into turrets, mines and drones before the next wave hits your base.

title: Dry Jerky Demo
description: This is the free playable demo for our upcoming game. Please check the main store page for full details, features, and to add the game to your wishlist!

title: Roguelette Demo
description: The roulette roguelike. Roguelette is a tactical, satisfying deckbuilder where you load a cursed wheel with strange balls, bend the odds with powerful effects, and trigger outrageous chain-reaction combos.

title: 大烟枪 Demo
description: I Got Smoke is a pixel-art, top-down action game. Play as a traditional cigarette and kill every vape. Gunfights, close combat, executions—kill everything you see, or be killed.

title: Legends of Goodness Demo
description: Build your settlement, produce gold, wood, and food, and raise an army in the Legends of Goodness demo. Command your forces against the Reptilian Legion in real-time battles, or take direct control of a hero with Hero Takeover to reclaim your lands.

title: The Haunting Demo
description: Interact with the board, communicate in the dark, and use your social deduction skills to survive in The Haunting. A multiplayer horror party game for up to 10 players.

title: SEC//SIM — Security Engineer Simulation Demo
description: At 1 a.m., stand watch as a defensive AI in a SOC. Play SEC//SIM's first three nights and an exclusive fourth, Two Sounds. Check signals, trace hosts and keys, earn human approval, then strike at once. Can you spot the quiet move behind a ransomware countdown? Four nights lead into the full story.

title: Greed for Glory Demo
description: In this chaotic board game, take on the roles of creatures straight out of fables. Use your wits and think carefully about every move to become the richest among your friends and claim the throne. Then, watch your plans unfold before your eyes, because in a fable, nothing ever goes quite as planned.

title: Dig to Mole Dorado Demo
description: Burrow deep into the earth in this short incremental digging game. Hunt for treasure, upgrade your powers and experience the low-key story of a mole and his dad on a grand adventure.

title: Fool Demo
description: You're a jester traveling the realm solving people's problems with the power of juggling. You'll save relationships, resolve conflicts like battles, and even make crops grow all with the mystical power of juggling!

title: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown Demo
description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

title: Tainted Tide Demo
description: The world is drowning, and the Tainted are evolving. Scavenge, upgrade your raft, and survive each passing day in this roguelite survival RPG. Master match-3 combat, dodge deadly attacks, craft powerful abilities, and fight to finish a mission humanity cannot afford to lose.

title: 핏빛 비가 내린 날 Demo
description: The Day It Rained Blood is an adult dark-romance visual novel where you choose between a girl cursed to die each day and a childhood friend blessed by fate. Enter the tragedy beneath the blood rain to save her—or turn from the curse and protect your peaceful life.

title: The Child Who Serves the Hanul Demo
description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

title: Void Walkers X64 Demo
description: Embark on a classic 2D overhead RPG adventure inspired by the golden era of 16-bit classics. Forge your destiny across five distinct progression paths, master tactical combat, and explore a world where your choices unlock powerful hybrid classes.
developer: Luminous Lodge, Liminal Lore, IIRIS engine

title: 三国权谋模拟器 Demo
description: Three Kingdoms Strategy Simulator is an AI-native historical strategy title. Every NPC possesses independent cognition and persistent long-term memory. None of the regional warlords are pre-scripted routines hardcoded into the game engine。

title: Grade A Demo
description: A first-person incremental game about producing omelette mix by tossing eggs into a processing vat. Stack multipliers, build combo chains, and optimize egg throughput. Get introduced to another trainee who's anxious to get out. Will you discover who's telling the truth?

title: Worldkampf '72 Demo
description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

title: Kaiju Defense Project Demo
description: Kaiju Defense Project is a strategy game set in a distant world where humanity is fighting to survive against hordes of giant monsters: the Kaijus. Research, manage, and strategically build your defenses to keep humanity alive on this planet. How much time does humanity have left?

title: Leviathan: Rhino Demo
description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

title: PLINKOJI Demo
description: PLINKOJI is a Plinko-roguelike about outsmarting randomness. Build your deck from emoji pins, hunt for absurd synergies, take risks and lose - just to come back stronger and find that one game-breaking combo. Defeat isn't the end - it's the beginning of a new strategy.

title: Living with a Runaway Girl ~A Lovey-Dovey Life with Lowkey Gamer High School Girl~ Demo
description: Your cousin, a lowkey high school girl Hikariko, ran away from home and came to live with you! Have a chat, get lap pillows, sleep side-by-side! Enjoy a cool yet super sweet, affectionate yet nonchalant, lovey-dovey cohabit simulator with Hikariko♪

title: Where the Hell Is My Game? Demo
description: Explore one trash pile, find rare items and collectible cards, and sell your finds to buy upgrades that make collecting easier. The full game offers more piles to explore in your search for the lost game cartridge.

title: THERMOCLINE Demo
description: A BLIZZARD RAGES. Lone survivor, you are STRANDED upon a FRIGID CORPSE-PLANET. THEY seek your warmth, sucking Soul from the shadows. AND TONIGHT, THE WIND IS YOUR CLOSEST SEMBLANCE OF A FRIEND.

title: Astro Fighters 3 Demo
description: The aliens have returned. Experience the first two levels of Astro Fighters 3 in full, unlock 6 powerful player ships and 70 Enhancement Cards, and survive procedurally generated Gauntlet Modes in this action-packed arcade shoot 'em up.

title: TRACE Demo
description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

title: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage Demo
description: Lyssa is a tactical card-based RPG featuring turn-based battles.Assemble a powerful squad of unique mercenaries, choose a mighty commander, and develop a winning strategy. Combine your heroes' abilities, experiment with different team compositions, and prove your tactical skills in intense battles.

title: We Are So Cooked Demo
description: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

title: Dark Well Demo
description: Dark Well is a platformer deck-building roguelike. Every weapon brings its own skill cards — adjust your loadout to shape your deck. Craft gems with wild affixes to empower your cards. Use cards to move, take the angle, dodge the killing blow. Keep going down and explore the sunless depths!

title: Prof. Bringoo's Big Dumb Block Factory Demo
No Rest for Thieves Demo
description: No Rest for Thieves is a first-person party game for four. Split the loot after midnight—or steal your friends’ share. Nod off, lose your cash! Use wild gadgets to stay awake and put rivals to sleep. The highest total coin value wins. Watch your eyelids—and your friends.

title: Neko Room Days Demo
description: Care for cats, collect furniture, and create a room of your own in this cozy 2D pixel-art simulation. Enjoy 60+ lo-fi tracks, a Pomodoro timer, and a stopwatch while you work, study, or unwind.

title: Proper Football Boss Demo
description: Remember when football was proper? Let us take you back 40 years — to when naming two subs was still a luxury and the only seven-figure salaries were in Italian lira. The demo allows you to play one full season. Your save game will be compatible with the full release.

title: 무고한 사람 Demo
description: 팀 관포지교가 선보이는 가장 유쾌한 피카레스크! 진실보다는 현실을 좇는 변호사가 되어 반성의 여지 없는 의뢰인을 변호하는 게임입니다. 사건의 단서를 모아 '입맛대로' 진상을 재구성하고, 누가 봐도 죄가 깊은 의뢰인을 무죄로 만들어줍시다.

title: Dream Daughter Demo
description: You are the dreaming Daughter trapped in the World authored by others. You too must build the World. The rules are waiting for you. You build and watch the World forge your reality. Confront it and wake up or forever linger in its lies.

title: 테일즈: 잉크 가디언 (TALES: INK GUARDIAN) Demo
description: A top-down action game where you cut down corrupted fairy tale monsters with a fast, combo-driven leek blade, defend against endless waves, and dive into rift dungeons to plant seeds, extract rewards, and build your own playstyle.

title: Desktop Fighter Demo
description: Turn your desktop into a living battleground! In this free-to-play idle RPG, your stickman fighter battles while you work. Collect loot and chests, merge items into stronger gear, improve your build, and hunt for rare tradable items.

title: Mournhill Demo
description: A free taste of Mournhill. Play a few cases, collect a handful of endings, and meet the red door nobody talks about.

title: Arithmeria Demo
description: Arithmeria is a non-violent RPG for kids that replaces traditional combat with arithmetic questions and realm restoration. Enjoy a full adventure campaign followed by a robust endgame built for grinding and farming!

title: Ephemera Demo
description: Witness the rise and fall of the Mai Kingdom through the lives of heroes Ilhan and Rashel, as turn-based tactics meets Mughal era fantasy. Plan your battles, manage your relationships, and make choices with devastating consequences as you search for the truth about the ancient city of the Ephemera.

title: Escape from Doomstown Demo
description: A post-apocalyptic survival game where you lead a squad of survivors into a zombie-infested town. Scavenge for supplies, take down dangerous foes, and get out before the horde closes in. Build your base, recruit survivors, strengthen your squad, and fight your way out of this doomed city!

title: Extreme Cleaning Simulator Demo
description: Try Extreme Cleaning Simulator Demo and get a first taste of cleaning the most neglected and disgustingly filthy homes. Remove piles of trash, scrub stubborn stains, and see if you have what it takes for the dirtiest jobs.

title: Billy the Hero Demo
description: Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now. A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.

title: Smash & Stash Demo
description: Try the opening of Smash & Stash: slam face-down caps, flip them over, fill your first sets and face the first rivals who come knocking. About an hour of play, and everything you collect carries over to the full game.

title: Kingdom Isles Demo
description: Kingdom Isles is an intense Survival City Builder with Roguelike elements. Build a mighty Kingdom, Trade resources on the market, and defend your Island against increasingly tougher Viking raids! Can you lead your people to victory?

title: Hold My Cargo Demo
description: Try the single-player demo of Hold My Cargo, a first-person space smuggling sim. Carry physical cargo, explore ports in the first galaxy and face customs aboard the starter ship SPAWN. A small operation can still get you into trouble.

title: YGGDRA: Path of Relics Demo
description: The World Tree is corrupted, and the Nine Worlds tremble. Assemble your deck with 50+ unique Valkyries and march toward Yggdrasil's heart! Only your strategy can prevent destruction. Experience Roguelite Deck-building meets Norse Mythology in Yggdrasil: Fragments of the World Tree.

title: 渔乐圈 Demo
description: 工作学习间隙，你的渔场全程自动运转：鱼竿自动挂机垂钓、员工值守打理渔场、顾客前来岸边垂钓。随时上线点开，就能沉浸式体验放置经营的松弛感。 Demo 试玩版内置全部可游玩系统： 野钓垂钓系统 渔场经营（设施建造、购买、升级） 鱼种图鉴系统 员工管理系统 游戏商店系统 Demo 仅开放以上内容；完整版后续会解锁渔场扩建、特殊装饰等更多拓展玩法。 经营渔场，收获悠闲，随时上线来这里摸鱼小憩。 支持中文、单人游玩。 快来开启你的鱼塘主生活吧！

title: Zombie Crawlers Demo
description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

title: 天坑追匪 Demo
description: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on
developer: 杭州天阙采样文化传媒游戏公司, Liquid Meow

title: EXORCIST K9 Demo
description: Breach the door, trust your extrasensory perception, and charge in with your Ghost Hunting Hound! Slain by a ghost? No problem—that's a tragedy you foresaw! Rewind to the door and break that death flag! ...Tired of dying? Take a quiet stroll with your good boy. Well, through a haunted house, anyway.

title: 崇祯模拟器 Demo
description: 1644—the Ming Dynasty is collapsing. Rebels close on Beijing, Manchu armies at the gates, the treasury empty. As Chongzhen, China's last emperor, you command AI-driven ministers who flatter, scheme, and defy you. Rewrite history—or fall as the records say?

title: Something's Off Demo
description: Something's Off — a hide-and-seek × spot-the-difference game. Play as Hider & Seeker: hide absurd oddities across handcrafted maps — surströmming in candy wonderland, a drone over 10th-century city, a pup napping on deep seabed. Hide the absurd, hunt time glitches. Something’s off, can you find it?

title: Desktop Buddy Demo
description: Paint your own ragdoll buddies, build moving contraptions and play with a physics toybox on your desktop. Create Scenes, take Direct Control, and choose between gentle play and optional blood effects, persistent wounds and mortal injuries.

title: GODBLADE Demo
description: Steal the gods' words and write the laws of your own sword. Fight through the courts of Anubis, Inanna, Susanoo and Ògún, chain law into law into law, expand a god's domain to change the rules of the fight, and come back stronger from every death.

title: Laguna Rosa: A long story with reckless consequences Demo
TeamSpec Demo
description: The class-based shooter where you can make your own class, both in terms of gameplay and looks!

title: ANU: Tablets of Thoth Demo
description: Accidentally resurrected from the dead, ANU must sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Harness the power of Anubis to defeat undead enemies, uncover hidden secrets, collect the lost fragments of the Emerald Tablet, and stop the sinister Voodoo Vulture in this 3D platforming adventure.

title: All Peaceful at the Adventurer`s Guild Today.(Demo)
The Adventurer's Guild Idler Demo
description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

title: Cinema Business Simulator Demo
description: Cinema Business Simulator is a single player business sim where you run your own cinema. License movies, set ticket options, and sell snacks. Prepare fresh popcorn and serve it from your popcorn cart!

title: Bound by Valor Demo
description: Defend the Flower of Life in a chaotic co-op action roguelike. Combine elemental powers, create broken builds on the fly, and survive relentless waves together.

title: Shoot Some Rocks Demo
description: A bullet hell roguelite about a lonely worker drinking alone in space on Christmas Eve. Survive waves of cosmic chaos, get a cold beer, and face five massive bosses inspired by real space calamities.

title: 无尽地下城 Demo
description: The demo highlights skill learning, equipment crafting, and combat. Defeat bosses of rising difficulty to unlock more resources and freedom, and get a first taste of the core loop: learn skills, craft gear, and combine your party's abilities for far more combat power than any single character.

title: Mount Lomyst Demo
