description: Mount Lomyst is a 2D action game about climbing to the summit of Mount Lomyst, using a grappling hook and wall climbing — without jumping.

title: RED RESET Demo
description: RED RESET a thrilling fast-paced combat, story-driven adventure where you come across memorable characters in a world where not everything is as it seems. Experience a history filled with secrets only the keen-eyed will unveil.

title: Undertone Demo
description: This title is an interactive narrative game set in an urban elite‑family backdrop, where a grand tale of revenge and political intrigue spanning three corporations unfolds.

title: Make the Bus Demo
description: Catch the bus or die trying! Dash, dodge, and survive a chaotic suburban neighborhood in this action roguelike about the world's worst morning commute. Buy upgrades, perfect your route, and reach the bus before time runs out.

title: RoboCat Café Demo
description: Get a taste of managing a cat café in the future the 2000s promised you. In this demo serve the cats and customers with delicious treats. Expand your menu with modern machines to grow your business and create a cozy environment with new decorations ☆

title: Deepest RESEARCH
description: Yuji is an elite lawyer. One day, his beautiful wife vanishes without a trace. Searching through her smartphone for clues, he follows the trail to uncover the truth behind her disappearance.

title: Ace Academy Demo
description: At Ace Academy, rank is won at the table and every debt is written in the Ledger. Gamble, read faces, raise the stakes, catch cheats in the act and cheat back if you dare. Climb a ladder of academy rivals through seven chapters of high-stakes anime drama, or end up expelled.

title: City Party Demo
description: Team up with friends, race around the board, claim territory, and earn coins. Then invest your winnings in restaurants and properties, collect rent, and watch your city grow richer with every match.

title: Supernatural Archives：The Frontrooms
description: A first-person light psychological horror exploration game. Explore unknown spaces, observe environmental anomalies, discover hidden clues, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets behind the Frontrooms.

title: Patchy Demo
description: An idle fishing game that lives on your desktop, right on top of your taskbar. Your chosen angler casts all day while you work or play. Click a bite for a better catch, fill your aquarium with your best fish, and keep watch for Patchy, the legendary fish nobody has ever caught.

title: 缚于邪神低语的少女 TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl Demo
description: 这是一部关于爱与救赎的视觉小说。 被墟神选中的那一刻起，沈暮云就不再是人类了。 杀不死的身体、脑海中永不停歇的饥饿、随时可能失控伤及无辜的力量——这些足以压垮一个少女的东西，她独自背负了多年。 直到那个秋夜，在一条暗巷里，她遇到了那个隶属“第零部门”、嬉皮笑脸却深不可测的陆长明。 从互相戒备到彼此依靠，两个异类的生活就此交缠。然而平静之下，信徒的阴谋与墟神的苏醒正一步步逼近……

title: Chinoris: Little Transporters Demo
description: Tiny, unseen Chinoris quietly fix the small things humans lose, at a cost few ever question. Alon is new to this life, and he hasn't learned to stop asking why. Venture through fields, forests, cities, and caves to uncover the truth, and decide what a life is really worth.

title: CyberMerit Demo
description: Free demo: the real Xiaoman, minus her voice. Pet, drag, farm merit through ten realms, notes, fortunes, Gomoku — all here. Chat stays locked, no AI. In the full game, link your own model and she talks, banters, and learns you. Like her? Wishlist the full version.

title: Vanguard Monsters Demo
description: Vanguard Monsters is a run-based creature raising roguelike autobattler.  Hatch a team, evolve them to more powerful forms, and collect gear to defeat the endless forces of the encroaching void.

title: Bloody Bridge (Demo)
description: Hold the bridge, save the stronghold! Bloody Bridge is a 2D turn-based Action RPG where you build your hero, battle enemy waves, and loot the fallen. Gear up in the town hub, learn new abilities from trainers, and craft custom spells at the Mage Tower.

title: Plushy's Playground: Into the Slide Demo
Project Horror Cleaner Demo
description: Uncover the truth behind a tobacco distributor office located in outskirts of city in Jakarta, Indonesia in year 1985. Explore, clean abandoned rooms, solve mysteries, and face the mystical being in this atmospheric horror game.

title: Time Stop Tower Defense Demo
description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

title: Black Roots Demo
description: Black Roots is a atmospheric 2.5D horror adventure. Guide a young boy through a stone-frozen village, utilizing an enchanted cap to reveal hidden ghostly paths and solve puzzles while evading terrifying spectral entities.

title: A Mirror Apart Demo
description: Explore a selection of mirrored environments from A Mirror Apart, where subtle differences between reflections reveal the path forward in this puzzle game.

title: Abarya Demo
description: Defend your core, gather resources, and build a deadly domain in Abarya. Use cards to construct defenses, power your economy, and unleash devastating abilities as relentless enemy waves push your strategy to its limit.

title: SpecterMancer Demo
description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

title: Together in Pieces: Jigsaw Puzzles Demo
description: A cozy jigsaw puzzle demo for solo play or online co-op with up to 8 players. Assemble puzzles together in real time, import your own images, and get a taste of what’s coming in the full release, including more content, features, and Steam Workshop support.

title: This Game Socks Demo
description: Mom won't let you touch a video game until you match your socks. In this demo, find, match and toss 5 pairs into the basket, earn coins and buy the Sock Magnet. The full game: 3,000 socks, 13 absurd gadgets and online co-op with friends.

title: Crops & Coops Demo
description: Play the whole first season of Crops & Coops for free: build a small island farm alone or in online co-op with up to three friends, grow crops, fish, raise hens and hire helpers. Your demo farm carries over to the full game.

title: Rogue Space Convoy Demo
description: In this demo, pilot the escort, build a civilian convoy, fight through route-driven campaigns of raiders, mines, and capital ships, and get every passenger to the jump gate alive.

title: St. Nicholas Night Demo
description: The Night of St. Nicholas is a night that rekindles the belief in miracles. Brave the snowstorm, wander through snow-covered streets, uncover hidden presents in a city fast asleep, and restore the magic of this heartwarming winter adventure.

title: BoxParty! Demo
description: BoxParty brings multiple online party games together in one platform. Join friends or strangers, jump into quick matches, bluff, guess, trick your opponents, and discover reimagined game modes with events, jokers, and advanced rules.

title: Staring Time Demo
description: First Person Psychological Horror game inspired by Inspired by Layers Of Fear and Slender Man. Dark rooms full of dark forces. Your only way to stay sane is to Stare at Time. One Demon will want you to look at it, DON'T! The others are afraid of the Light. The Extended Demo is part of CHAPTER 01.

title: Trash Inc. Demo
description: Turn a bankrupt recycling yard into a smooth-running operation in this relaxing incremental management game. Open bags and sort waste by hand, hire a crew, install processing machines, and automate the journey from truck delivery to valuable recycled goods.

title: Echoes of Nothing Demo
description: Explore the vast ruin of a massive colony ship, find powerful weapons, ships and equipment, and decide the fate of existence itself. Dodge bullets, distract missiles and outmaneuver your enemies, then retaliate with lasers and heavy artillery.

title: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion Demo
description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

title: They Cry Demo
description: They Cry is a psychological horror following Luke seeking to find the source of a reoccurring dream taking over his life, only to find the former husk of his hometown.

title: The Serena Villa Files Demo
description: 'FMV Queen' Wang Han's First K-FMV! At your new job as a security guard in a women's only residence, feelings blossom between you and the charming residents, but strange events also haunt you from your first day. What mystery awaits you and the five ladies of Serena Villa?

title: Eternal Chamber Demo
description: A psychological horror about repetition, isolation, and the need to keep moving forward. Keep pushing. Don't stop. Break through.

title: Fast Food Fortune Demo
description: If you can’t stand the heat, get out of the kitchen! Fast Food Fortune is a casual restaurant sim where you take a restaurant from the brink of financial ruin to a fast food fortune. Buy upgrades, update your restaurant, hire staff, and manage your way to the top of the fast food chain.

title: Paradox Boxing Demo
description: This is the demo for Paradox Boxing! Featuring the full opening of the game, along with a fight against a Knight in shining armorWith this demo you'll get a tantalizing taste of what's to come and the foes you'll face in the full game!

title: Homeplanet Demo
description: Demo ContentThe demo includes several missions from the full game, available to play without any restrictions. This content wasn't made specifically for the demo.AI Usage DisclaimerThe demo features character dialogue generated using large language models. This is not representative of the final game's quality.

title: Colorways Demo
description: Try to complete 7 free levels in the wave-based traffic mode in Colorways!

title: Loopy Demo
description: Demo gratuita do Steam Next Fest. Aprenda o laço, dispute quatro protocolos neon offline, jogue o Arcade completo e complete um Grid Gauntlet local. Wishlist LOOPY para rankings ao vivo e o lançamento em 29 out.

title: Vault Keeper: Tidy Up the Vault Demo
Legacy of the Griffin Demo
description: A narrative horror experience where you unravel the disturbing history of Michael Dubh. Your morality guides each decision, leading to multiple endings as you confront the secrets buried within his mansion and the fate that emerges from the shadows of your past.

title: Replay Rumble Demo
description: Fight alongside your past in a fast paced multiplayer arena! Every round adds your previous actions back into the battle, turning simple fights between four unique characters into ever growing temporal chaos.

title: Project Legend Demo
description: Create a young prospect and shape one footballer’s career across three complete seasons. Develop your player, experience simulation-driven matches and live highlights, navigate contracts and transfers, and make decisions that shape your future in Project Legend.

title: No Such Floor Demo
description: Work the night shift at a quiet hotel where routine tasks slowly turn into something far more unsettling. Clean rooms, help guests, manage the hotel, and explore strange events as the elevator begins taking you to floors that should not exist.

title: Absolute Dap Demo
description: Dap up your friend and fight bizarre bosses together! Absolute Dap is a co-op action boss rush about two best friends trying to stop an alien invasion from ruining their friend's first date. The game is ridiculous. The friendship isn't.

title: Windowed Realms Demo
description: A cozy desktop companion that turns your computer into interactive islands. Manage units, collect resources, and craft in transparent windows while you work or relax.

title: Fate & Felt Demo
description: Fate & Felt Demo is a focused slice of a single-player poker roguelite built on Texas Hold'em. Read opponents, judge your hand, manage chips, and decide when to check, call, raise, fold, or go all-in across the Pre-Flop, Flop, Turn, and River.

title: Gypt - The Eternal Pharaoh
description: Building and management rogue-lite set in ancient Egypt. Assign your artisans, raise your pyramid on a triangular grid, and riddle it with traps. Upon your death, watch your tomb brave 2,000 years of trials against raiders and the wrath of the gods.
developer: Studio Beija-Flor, Sophie Pagès, morningbee, Evan Beunet

title: Vauren's BeastBorn Demo
description: Vauren's BeastBorn is a competitive deck builder focused entirely on combos. Think your strategy, here, the real power lies in patience.Many effects evolve when they reach a certain number of stacks, transforming into more powerful (or completely different) versions of themselves.

title: PixelPainter 95 Demo
description: Fill the canvas. Then fill a bigger one. PixelPainter 95 is an incremental paint game on a 1995 desktop, from a single page toward a billion tiles. Widen your brush, hire painters that work while you are away, and print each page into a stronger start.

title: Spill The Ink Demo
description: Draw one continuous line and let gravity do the rest. Try 20 handcrafted physics puzzles, guide paper balls into their goals, and chase three-star clears with less ink. Build and test your own private chambers in the demo's level creator.

title: Idle Commander Demo
description: Build your own path in Idle Commander. Discover powerful gear, experiment with wild builds, and reshape your strategy with every drop.

title: Morphsea: Abyssal Evolution Demo
description: Begin at the bottom of the food chain. Shape your body as you hunt, grow, and evolve across a vast ocean. Journey from sunlit shallows to the lightless abyss, surviving changing environments and deadly predators as you explore the deepest reaches of the sea.

title: Apollyon Demo
description: Lead a team of up to six P.L.U.T.O. surveyors through G.A.T.E, a portal to the Backrooms created in 1979. Explore hand built rooms stitched together differently each run, stay close enough that your senses stay honest, and push further than the last expedition made it. Stay together. Trust no one.P.L.U.T.O RESEARCH DIVISION, 1979G.A.T.

title: Sacred Land Demo
description: This is a demo version of the game. Some content (playable characters and maps) are locked compared to the full game.A group of settlers has arrived on a lonely island, intent on claiming the land and it's resources for themselves.

title: Lingyun Cards: Between the Clear and the Turbid
description: Each additional card you chain makes your next strike hit even harder! Lingyun Cards: Between the Clear and the Turbid – an Eastern fantasy roguelite deckbuilder. Dive into mist-shrouded spirit realms, match wits with restless spirit beasts, counter their every move, and cut your way through!

title: 有宋将倾 Demo
description: History Has Already Written Its Fall. I Arrived Before the Ink Was Dry.My name is Zhao Chen.I've been transported through time.This is the first year of Shaoxing—1131 AD.When I opened my eyes again, I had become Zhao Chen—the Crown Prince of the Great Song, a man who should have vanished from history with the Jingkang Incident.

title: Is This Reversi? Demo
description: リバーシ盤を、もっと自由に。石を置く、裏返す、消す、投げる——ルールに縛られない盤と石で遊ぶ、テーブルトップ・サンドボックスの体験版です。ひとりでも、CPUとも、オンラインで友だちとも遊べます。

title: Waves Ahoy! Demo
description: Defend against sea creatures and pirates in Fata Morgana, a highly strategic deckbuilder! Collect cards, equip your crew, upgrade your ship, find treasures and craft your strategy on your journey to defeat evil Fairy Morgana.

title: Kebab Dynasty Demo
description: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

title: Evil Moon: Unspoken Demo
description: Boomer Shooter Metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

title: Seasons of Books and Keys Demo
description: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

title: The Silent Fare Demo
description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

title: Mark My Words Demo
description: The word-building roguelike. 'Mark My Words' is an addictive deckbuilder where you assemble high-scoring words, discover fancy Stickers, and utilize Glyphs to unleash intriguing combinations. Master the Art of Wordplay in several different Game modes!

title: 无言初雪与奇迹书 Demo
description: 江城是个很少下雪的南方城市。倘若是哪个冬天见到了，就随手纪念一下吧…在难以成团的雪籽融化成水之前，在眼前的人尚未走远消失之前，将“白色的奇迹”封存在相片里，记录在记事本里，铭刻于脑海里……

title: Split Second Volley Demo
description: Turn based anime-style sports battles! Create outrageous combos and last minute saves using teamwork and unique skills. You can even use guns! Outsmart your foes, choreograph larger than life moments, and win PvP battles with STYLE!

title: Defend Wallace Demo
description: A silly 1-4 player hoard defense game where you protect your completely oblivious best friend Wallace from an entire army of monsters. Pick your hero, annihilate enemies, and unlock/upgrade new skills to grow as strong as you need to be to KEEP WALLACE SAFE! He's useless but you all love him.

title: Raid Lead - Echoes of Gaia Demo
description: Raid Lead is a Strategy game about positioning and healing your Group. You fight different bosses with unique challenges to collect stat- and talentpoints to grow stronger.

title: All 4 Naught Demo
description: ALL 4 NAUGHT is a fantasy roguelike where you play as a team of 4 heroes battling monsters of the dark well. Gather riches, harness powerful abilities, discover new heroes and try to craft the perfect battalion to defeat the onslaught of enemies!

title: EMPTYLAND Demo
description: Explore a frozen nightmare in this cinematic first-person survival horror demo. Investigate an abandoned environment, solve environmental puzzles, manage your resources, unlock hidden areas, and survive terrifying encounters as you uncover the first pieces of a disturbing mystery.

title: LOCKOUT Demo
description: The free opening chapter of LOCKOUT. Wake on a quarantined island, follow a stranger's voice on the radio, get the lights on, and survive what the light wakes up. Around 15 to 20 minutes of stealth, puzzles, and dread.

title: Pump And Dump Demo
description: It's 1987 and you start in the mailroom. You have eight weeks to get your name on the door. Trade stocks, pump the ones you own, sell to dentists over the phone and keep the SEC off your back. A trading roguelite with scheme cards, a crew to hire and a new run every time.

title: Lord of the Tiles DEMO
description: Gradually uncover the world, discover new cities, connect them with roads, and turn a humble settlement into a prosperous kingdom. Develop your economy, unlock new mechanics, and explore the map at your own pace — with no combat and no unnecessary stress.

title: Deadstate Heroes Demo
description: Build a squad of 40+ unique heroes, combine their abilities, classes, and factions, and find effective strategies for fully automated battles. Develop your heroes and settlement in a world overrun by the undead.

title: Paper War - Last Stand Demo
description: Hold your ground on a paper-styled battlefield. Paper War - Last Stand Demo is a single-player, top-down survival shooter. Dodge enemy fire, gather supplies, and build your loadout between waves.Keep moving. Keep firing.Automatic fire lets you focus on movement. Use manual aiming when you need more control, and roll out of danger.

title: Shattermine Idle Demo
description: An incremental mining game built around powerful, upgradeable abilities. Break ores, automate your mine with workers, prestige for permanent upgrades, and turn abilities into increasingly devastating tools as your operation grows.

title: Rest In Space Demo
description: Space funeral bureau simulator. Find the forgotten dead among the stars, uncover their stories through wreckage and belongings. Choose burial methods and select grave adornments in accordance with the deceased's culture or final wishes.

title: Kung Fu Addiction Demo
description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

title: Undergone Demo
description: Take a first look at Undergone, an emotional journey where you explore a stunning world through photography, and unravel the mystery behind its transformation. It is not just a game about taking pictures. it is about what you choose to see!

title: Offworlders: Galactic Ventures Demo
description: Top-down space trading and combat on a working frontier. Run cargo, hunt salvage, fight pirates, and build a corporation that survives twenty cycles of pressure from the Cryos Foundation, the Frontier Allegiance, and the Sable Syndicate.

title: Pizza Turbo Demo
description: A pizza box on wheels. A deadly city. Zero margin for error. A high-speed arcade racing game where you chain together tricks, use power-ups, and survive the chaos—nuclear explosions, UFOs, and guys dressed as pineapples—before your pizza gets cold.

title: Clicker Tactics: Memorian Demo
description: A clicker × auto-battle tactics game where you place your companions on a 3×3 grid. Link chains with a wide variety of skills and relics, and mow down the hordes surging toward you. An exhilarating incremental RPG where every adventure makes you stronger.

title: Gemmy Gems: A Cozy Shop Sim Demo
description: Ever wanted to run your own little jewelry shop in a fantasy world? Collect gems, polish them up, and sell them to your customers. Get to know them along the way, too ✨

title: Fruit slicer Demo
description: Slice fruit with precision - using your mouse or real hand! Dodge bombs, master combos, and push your reflexes to the limit in this fast-paced arcade slicer. Try classic slicing as the cat or elephant, with a first-session tutorial to get you started.

title: SKROLL Demo
developer: Emilio Rivas, Luis Suárez, Rubén García

title: The Curator Demo
description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game. Upgrade your van, organize artworks for synergies, upgrade your artists, and satisfy picky visitors as you push across a branching map of biomes.

title: Dark Harvest Demo
description: Dark Harvest is a retro-styled stalker horror inspired by Resident Evil and Signs. Your dog is trapped, and something is stalking you. Explore the manor, solve puzzles, and do everything in your power to survive.

title: Lunar Wardens Demo
description: Build a team of elemental creatures and fight for the league title with up to 8 friends. Hire, hunt and evolve your creatures between matches, then set your line-up and watch every bout play out live in the moonlit arena.

title: Motocross The Force Demo
description: Motocross The Force delivers a high octane racing experience that is easy to pick up but demands true dedication to master.This demo allows you to play one track of the full game. You can play single player or online multiplayer player with your friends.
developer: SHANGHAI CHAPEROT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

title: Patient Zero: Plague Idle Demo
description: In the demo version of Patient Zero: Plague Idle, you can start with any of the four pathogen types and evolve it to challenge humanity. Four pathogens, global map, and strategic choices - the epidemic begins here.

title: What Do You Meme?® The Video Game Demo
GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown Demo
description: Your first step into a living world. This free demo of GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown is being prepared around third-person exploration, village and forest encounters, and the beginning of a journey with a wolf companion.

title: Math Defense Protocol Demo
developer: 日食网络 Solar Eclipse studio

title: Slingbox Demo
description: A minimalist physics platformer built on momentum. Dash, tether, and launch through a decaying simulation: zero gravity first, then gravity and corruption. Beat the clock, earn medals, perfect every route.

title: Memory House Demo
description: Your first quiet evening in Memory House. Try illustrated Jigsaw puzzles, an introductory Atlas strategy scenario, five detective chapters, a complete fairy tale, and a small personal journal, with music and changing weather. Available in English and Russian.

title: Azzog's Idle Asteroid Demo
description: Meet Azzog, your cozy desktop companion. Mine, fish, collect cards, and head out on expeditions while Azzog quietly gets on with life alongside your other windows. Get a first taste of your own little idle asteroid.

title: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead Demo
description: Apocalypse! You run the last kebab shop in a ruined world. In the demo, serve hungry survivors, grill questionable meat. Deliveries across wastelands. Tense days. ZOMBONERS attacks at night! Will the shop survive? Enter the apocalypse grill!

title: Periphery Demo
description: Periphery is a psychedelic action-horror game. Uncover the truth about your workspace, get introduced to the locals and their gnostic fascination. Warp into the pixelated world of Periphery and experience surreal world built on mystery.

title: Monster Meadows - Online Board Game Demo
description: Zarı at ve büyülü haritayı fethet! Canavar yuvalarını geliştir, eşsiz karakter yeteneklerini serbest bırak ve bu kaotik çok oyunculu parti oyununda arkadaşlarını iflas ettir.

title: The Golden Horde: Survival Demo
description: Enter the world of the Golden Horde and experience its harsh medieval steppe. Gather resources, hunt, craft weapons, armor, and healing items, fight different enemies, and protect your yurt on wheels as you begin your journey.

title: Per My Last Email Demo
description: The free demo of PER MY LAST EMAIL — the first three business days. The account you inherited is not new: it belonged to E. Vale, who is no longer with the company. You choose what you say, then choose who sees it. The routing is permanent. Someone is still reading.

title: Town Hall Demo
description: The free demo of TOWN HALL. Most of the town has left, but the town hall still opens at nine. You are the clerk, and whatever your stamp approves becomes true — permits, licenses, names, deaths. Everyone who reaches your desk brings a reason, and most bring money.

title: 渊生 ABYSSAL Demo
description: Hunt, evolve and build your own monster in a dark 2D ecosystem. Drag organs onto your body, time your evolution for a full-health comeback, and grow from one cell into a colony. Break out of the petri dish or chase survival records on Steam’s global Endless leaderboard.

title: The Off-Season Demo
description: The free demo of THE OFF-SEASON. You are the winter caretaker of a seaside hotel nobody visits between October and March. The owner's rules are pinned beside the key board: no guests. Then somebody knocks — after the last bus, in the rain, with cash and no booking.

title: The Previous Owner Demo
description: The free demo of THE PREVIOUS OWNER. Run a secondhand bookshop in London, 1994. Every book remembers who owned it before — pressed flowers, letters, notes in the margins. You inherited the rules with the shop: shelve carefully, and do not read the margins.

title: PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED Demo
description: The free demo of PLEASE CONFIRM THE DECEASED — the first two nights of the shift. Bodies arrive with paperwork, and the paperwork has to match the body. Weigh it, measure it, take its temperature. The rulebook gains a page every night, and some of what you sign in does not stay signed in.

title: 1453: Fall of Constantinople Demo
description: Constantinople, 1453. The free opening of an illustrated historical novel: play a janissary — born Greek, taken as a boy — from his first sight of the walls to the morning four ships humiliated an army. About 45 minutes. One of four testimonies, and the city remembers all of them.

title: Dear Nobody Demo
description: The free first three chapters of an epistolary romance. You are a censor, blacking out the letters of two lovers who have never met — so every word you strike is struck from the love itself. Then the letters begin, impossibly, to answer your pen. Wishlist for all six endings.

title: Plague Inc: The Board Game: The Video Game Demo
AstroPoly Demo
description: Explore procedurally generated planets, mine valuable ores, upgrade your gear, and set out for the next world in this space mining game. The demo can be played through the third planet.

title: 永眠之匣雪上之樱 Demo
description: 《永眠之匣，雪上之樱》是一款以殡仪馆为舞台的剧情向视觉小说！ 没错，殡仪馆！ 这是一个关于"告别"与"陪伴"的故事，温馨，治愈，偶尔塞你一口刀（ 本作25万字全程语音，无分支主线，十余个EX小剧场，全通后还有打破第四面墙的Meta剧情等着你！ 没有黑深残，大家都有happy end~请放心游玩(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)
developer: 系梦社, 瞌睡的坐标

title: HEROES' BATTLE HYMN：Demonfire Era Demo
description: This retro Chinese pixel RPG is set in a fiend-infested world. Recruit heroes, use dual skill trees and team combos. Explore, battle foes, fight the demonfire plague, banish darkness and raise your battle hymn.

title: Chinese Childhood Demo
description: Spend an afternoon in a small Chinese town around 1998. Play marbles, buy snacks, and head home when Mum calls. This free demo includes the next school day and an optional Mid-Autumn evening. Choose a boy or girl and take your time.

title: Glowing Static Demo
description: Play the first game in a series of retro games and learn about what's really going on in your bedroom.

title: Anywhere RPG Demo
description: An AI-directed RPG that unfolds in real time.

title: F.I.S.H. 2 Demo
description: This demo includes the first 3 levels of the game.

title: 兰岛物语2：奇沧的幻海 Demo
Tuanbot Demo
description: Tuanbot is a pixel-art desktop character app with interactive animations, text-based AI chat, and multi-agent discussions. Enter /takeover in a character chat window to control the character with WASD or arrow keys. This free demo contains no in-app purchases.

title: Booty Battler Demo
description: SinglePlayer Roguelike meets Auto-Battler Card game! Manage a crew of pirates to fight through endless auto-battles while collecting powerful relics, managing cursed loot, upgrading the ship and casting spells.

title: TAKTAKTOP Demo
description: Vertical jump action to escape the sky! Shoot projectiles to pave your way in Build Mode, or adapt to shifting tiles in Random Mode. Pass tokens via missiles to aid or revive allies—stay immune while tokenless. Reach the top exit with tokens to win! (Up to 12 players online)

title: Switch Ball Deluxe Demo
description: Switch colors on the fly to destroy all energy bricks in sight! Bounce, boost, and race the clock through more than 160 handcrafted levels across 10 power plant themed worlds in this arcade puzzle-platformer. Chase S-ranks in Adventure Mode, or put your skills to the test in the Gauntlet!

title: Greedy Getaways Demo
description: Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh every excursion.

title: マキコマレイド Demo
description: This is the demo version of Makicomaraid. Pull in enemy bullets, sweep them up, and smash them into your foes! An intuitive shooter anyone can enjoy! Alta, a boy who picks up a mysterious disc, sets off into the "sea of data" that lies within it.

title: Unfree Freesia Demo
description: The Demo version of Unfree Freesia. A narrative-driven game where Deduction meets the Dark Arts. Invest crime scenes for evidence and navigate the razor's edge between "Rationality" and "Inspiration." Unlock branching paths through your choices, and decide who survives the encroaching shadows.

title: SuperStore Simulator Demo
description: Run your own store in this three-day demo of SuperStore Simulator. Stock shelves, set prices, serve customers at the checkout, and track your earnings. Experience the daily challenges of managing a neighborhood market.

title: All the Promised Burn - An Yssaia Game Demo
description: ALL THE PROMISED BURN is a hand-drawn Knowledge-based RPG about what an assassin does after the War ends. Can you learn new ways to be, when the past is still burned into you?

title: SYSADMIN Hell Demo
description: You're the sole sysadmin for a company scaling from 10 to 100,000 employees. Everything breaks. Everything. Automate your way out of ticket hell or watch it all burn.

title: Final Armada Demo
description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

title: DUE TONIGHT Demo
description: The free demo of DUE TONIGHT: the first three floors of a building that never stops sending you googly-eyed paperwork. Stamp, pay the quota, get promoted, hire your first team and survive three Performance Reviews. About 30 to 45 minutes.

title: Hunt The Ducks Demo
description: Hunt The Ducks is an addictive shooter that combines retro arcade nostalgia with modern incremental progression. Hunt flocks of ducks, earn coins, upgrade your arsenal, unlock auto-fire systems, and build an unstoppable hunting empire!

title: I hate progress bars Demo
description: A short incremental clicker about the progress bar that stops at 99%. Destroy bars by hand, unlock skills that click for you, and fight through installers, updates and a blue screen — one bar at a time, then hundreds at once.

title: Mighty Mahjong Demo
description: Still playing mahjong with 13 tiles? Mighty Mahjong is a next-gen twist where you start one tile short — and that missing tile becomes a wild card! Outsmart opponents with bold strategy and sharp reads. Anime-style online battles, special rules, team modes, and fast-paced matches. Free to play!

title: Croissant Simulator Demo
description: Manage your own croissant restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh croissants, purchase ingredients, manage your inventory, and keep your customers happy. No distractions—just a focused, single-player croissant simulation.

title: Rock Paper Viking Demo
description: You are the sole defender of the Cardboard Castle! Pick up new weapons and magic abilities as you progress. Level up your loot to gain the strength of the Norse Gods, and defeat your foes to claim victory for your kin.

title: EXAM WATCH! Demo
description: In academia, every decision matters. In the exam hall, it's not just about catching cheaters, but making the right call. From student relationships to career choices, every step shapes your reputation and future. Write your own academic story and decide what reaching the top is worth.

title: NyanDrop Demo
description: NyanDrop is a physics puzzle: connect four or more blocks with the same pattern to clear them. Stack cleverly and aim for chain reactions. One more round with the cats! The demo lets you enjoy a portion of the game.

title: Arcade & Motel Simulator Together Demo
description: Run a neon-lit roadside motel with an arcade next door. Haggle with guests, upgrade rooms, play eight fully playable arcade games, cook burgers for hungry players and manage it all from your retro tablet, solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Steel Company Demo
description: The Steel Company demo showcases the turn-based, tactical-scale combat engine, featuring >20 scenarios as well as custom battles and the scenario editor. The demo features most of the major powers of WWII (including Germany, USSR, USA, UK, and Japan).

title: Dollastro 52 Demo
description: Attack to the beat, bring charming Dolls from screen to life, and start your collection in this rhythm action demo featuring ten Doll encounters.

title: Brothers Demo
description: A cooperative medieval action game where you and your brother fight through dangerous environments, take on powerful enemies, and grow stronger together. Brothers serves as the foundation and showcase for a much larger co-op experience currently in development.

title: Nooodles: Brutalism Edition Demo
description: A laid-back idle network-building game. Lay connections, build nodes. Tokens flow through your network, constantly meeting and merging, generating revenue at ever-higher values — revenue builds more nodes, nodes pass more tokens, tokens... you get the idea.

title: Pomo Valley Demo
description: Pomo Valley is a cozy pixel farming game you can only tend on the breaks between focus rounds. Focus to grow your crops, then step out to till, plant, harvest, mine, chop, trade and build up your valley.

title: Deck Drop Demo
description: Perfect your deck or watch it burn! Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro. Can you beat the Tipping Point?

title: Red Soil Demo
description: Survive the heat and the undead in this isometric horror game set in the Australian outback. Manage stamina, hydration, hunger, and fatigue while exploring random maps, leveling up, crafting gear, and to fight in the heat of the day or the darkness of night.

title: Farm & Drive Demo
description: Farm trucks with a crew on the back fight on one fenced farm. Cut crops for coins, spend them on crew between rounds, and watch them fight for you. A chaotic auto-battler on wheels for 1 to 4 players. The demo has the first three stages, every crew member and full multiplayer.

title: Lurks Beneath Demo
description: Investigate a little girl's disappearance at a rundown trailer park. Play as Detective Partridge and cross examine three suspects to find the truth with fully freeform interrogation. Type anything and ask anything you want.

title: Recycle Rivals Demo
description: A multiplayer junkyard game for 1 to 4 players, as a team or as rivals. Smash junk with a sledgehammer, sort it, bale it and sell it in town. Invent machines and vehicles, build a line that runs itself, and turn a pile of scrap into a machine empire

title: Necrotel: No Checkout Demo
description: Necrotel: No Checkout is a unique management and crafting simulator set within the walls of a grim, gothic hotel. You play as an underground surgeon managing a getaway for eccentric nobles and monsters to fund your forbidden necromantic experiments.

title: Football Card Tycoon Demo
description: Open your own football card shop! Stock up, rip packs, set your prices, and hunt holo, autograph, and serial-numbered cards. Build an all-star lineup, conquer the card leagues, and win the World Championship!

title: The Dungeon's Guardian: Rise of the monsters Demo
description: The Dungeon's Guardian: Rise of the monsters Demo is a Demo build of a Tactical Autobattler Roguelike where you build an army of monsters, upgrade them and combine their unique abilities and affinities to create powerful teams and defend your dungeon against waves of adventurers. Stop them all!

title: Arcade Together Demo
description: Run the arcade. Play the arcade. Together. Team up with friends to run your very own arcade! From classic cabinets to extreme experiences, from a corner shop to a grand entertainment center — build your arcade empire, side by side!

title: Wizard Jars: Tidy Up Together Demo
description: Wizard Jars is a cozy solo and co-op sorting game where you organize 3,240 magical jars in a chaotic apothecary, with 648 available in the demo. Put every jar back on its shelf, fulfill magical customer requests, unlock useful upgrades, and restore the apothecary to perfect order.

title: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot Demo
description: An incremental loot game where you drop your heroes onto hordes of slimes. They do the fighting, you grab the loot and fill your treasure chest. When time runs out, it bursts and rains it all back down. Upgrade your army in a huge skill tree and go again for a bigger haul.

title: 降雪的日子 Demo
description: 2011年，世界在下雪。我们站在无法前进亦无法后退的雪原上。 明天就会是世界末日，关于所有不寻常的叙事与抒情，面对结局与奇观化，一个关于我们的过错，我们的自我与他人的故事。

title: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia Demo (喵在江湖 Demo)
description: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia is a desktop-pet idle RPG set in a wuxia world of cats. Train Inner Arts, advance through realms, learn skills, collect gear, unlock meridians, and mix different builds to raise your own feline martial arts hero.

title: Kingfall Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards move like chess pieces. Build an army, bless your troops, and conquer the kingdom one battle at a time.

title: Wobble Demo
description: Wobble is a chaotic 2D brawler with no health bar — every hit pushes you closer to the edge. Draft skill cards between rounds, stack broken builds, and knock your friends off the map. Fast local and online matches

title: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim Demo
Librarian Together: Manga Tidy Up Demo
description: In Demo, tidy up a chaotic Tokyo manga shop in first-person online co-op for 1–4 players: grab, shelve and throw manga, chat by voice and try team skills. Every volume in its place. Together.

title: VPet Sort Together: Cozy Tidy Up Demo
description: A cozy organizing sim for 1–4 players: sort 9,600+ virtual pet toys — egg keychains, boxed pets, watches, rings and more — onto the shelves of a pastel VPet shop. Toss, stack and tidy up the chaos together, unlock skills and perks, no timer.

title: Gacha Chaos Tidy Up Together Demo
description: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and SLAP capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

title: One Second Hero Demo
description: One Second Hero is a first-person puzzle game where one second is all the time you need. Observe the world in an instant, interact with objects, use the environment, and turn danger around—before that second is over.

title: Undying Knights Demo
description: Undying Knights is a couch and online party game that fuses strategy and reflexes. Enjoy quick rounds with unique weapons and deadly traps.

title: Cup Or Die Demo
description: Every cup is a gamble. Play deadly beer pong, take your chances, and find a way out.

title: 方寸三国 Demo
description: 《方寸三国》是一款融合了征战模式的自走棋策略游戏。你将掌控三国时期的一方势力，组建属于你的强力队伍，攻城掠地，逐步实现天下一统的宏图伟业。

title: LAMINA BRUISE Demo
description: LAMINA BRUISE is a narrative-driven, first-person adventure set in a surreal sci-fi world. A tense yet meditative experience, paced by thoughtful puzzles. Play the demo for an introduction to the story and mechanics.

title: Blocks Utopia Demo
description: Blocks Utopia is a block-building game with real physics simulation. Use customizable blocks freely, or wait for adorable characters to release sky lanterns that carry surprise special blocks. Build, collect, unwind. No time limits, no failures. Stack your little utopia, and let your dreams land.

title: Bugs & Birdies Demo
description: A cozy survival sandbox with teeth – alone or in online co-op for up to four players. Explore a world of pixel islands, build your farmstead, raise an army of hens and hold the fences together when the beetles come at night.

title: Carpet Daddy Demo
description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this free first-person cleaning simulator demo. Play the tutorial and your first mission, with a limited selection of tools and upgrades.

title: REALM ARCANA Demo
description: REALM ARCANA is an online 1v1 card battler where you become an Arcana Master, collect cards from different realms, build your own deck, and face other players across battlefields with strange and ever-changing rules.

title: LifeStock Demo
description: You are a god. Mortal lives are stocks. A godlike life-trading strategy game. Draft mortal lives, trade their futures, manipulate fate and wage war against rival gods in a living medieval village.

title: Minty Spherez Demo
description: A revival of classic ball-rolling games, with HD graphics, delicious sound effects and several gamemodes to master.

title: Lost Camp Demo
description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

title: Boardroom Wars: Fight for Kashistan Demo
Gold Digger Demo
description: Dig for gold, buy more shovels, and hire cute animals to dig for you. Turn a small patch of land into a busy mine in this relaxing game.

title: PALE WHISPERS Demo
description: Play the opening of PALE WHISPERS. Wake at the edge of the Veil as a ghost with forty days left, fight the Shades in the dark Wastes, find your first Soul Shards, and reach the town where lost souls wait. Your choices begin here.

title: Buildmaxxing Demo
description: Build together on floating islands in this 1-4 player co-op building game. Each player has a unique role. Memorize blueprints, communicate with your team, and build from memory before time runs out!

title: Vasya Run Demo
description: Explore, a courier and graffiti artist caught in an extraterrestrial invasion amidst a society ruled by surveillance. Can speed and infiltration skills be enough?

title: Ultimate Girlfriend Experience Demo
description: Create and customize your own girlfriend character and let her stay on your computer while chilling, watching movies, playing or even working.

title: UNDELIVERED Demo
description: A short demo for the upcoming game UNDELIVERED. An unfinished glimpse into the final game.

title: Augment Mahjong Demo
description: A single & multiplayer game blending Riichi Mahjong with a rule-breaking Augment system. Acquire cards each round to override the board's rules. Combine System Overrides and your Augments to create powerful synergies! Enjoy this thrilling variant with friends or sophisticated AI.

title: Gun Garden Demo
description: Gun Garden is a dungeon crawler top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Explore rooms, find gear, fight enemies, and gain perks as you progress through the various floors, attempting to find what lies at the end of the Gun Garden.

title: Memory Matrix Pro Demo
description: Memory Matrix Pro Demo: Exercise your memory, free

title: Ritual Break Demo
description: Ritual Break is a co-op boss rush bullet hell where two heroes combine their abilities, manipulate enemy attacks, and face colossal demonic bosses within an ancient ritual arena.

title: Knowlands: Battle of Wits Demo
description: Knowlands is a trivia/real-time strategy game where knowledge is your greatest weapon. Conquer territory, command your army, and answer questions to defeat your opponents in fast-paced battles of strategy and wits.

title: Pocket Chef Demo
description: A tiny chef is waiting for you on your desktop! 🍳Pocket Chef is a cozy desktop pet cooking adventure game.A cute little chef lives on your desktop and prepares delicious meals for animal customers who visit your kitchen.Use your keyboard and mouse to help the chef cook dishes, satisfy customers, and earn rewards.

title: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon Demo
description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Play the demo this spooky season!

title: Kick The Wallet Demo
description: In this game, you must build a machine that will feed you a ton of coins, before promptly killing you to regenerate the coins. It is a casual sci-fi roguelike where the items you have access to are randomized each turn and employ physics to get you where you need to be.

title: SIFT Demo
description: Free SIFT demo: 10 solo levels + 3 bonus levels, plus online co-op and versus with your Steam friends (2 to 6 players). Fire your hook, push off thin air, dodge the traps and reach the door, faster every time.

title: Roll of Chaos Demo
description: Roll the dice and embrace the chaos in an epic roguelike where every decision could save you or destroy you... Combine abilities, create unique builds, and upgrade your character with every run while facing enemies with unique powers that change every battle!

title: Neo Bananas Demo
description: Get a taste of Neo Bananas, a speedrun platformer where you run, jump and slash fruits for the fastest time possible!

title: Brainrot Fire Demo
description: Brainrot Fire is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter with four intense game modes — from free-for-all chaos to trivia-gated showdowns. Outscore, outlast, and outsmart your opponents!

title: Desktop Witch Demo
description: A simple incremental game where you help your local desktop witch, Zemma, fend off enemies with the power of your clicks.

title: FIRETOMINE Demo
description: You find yourself stranded alone on an island, and the first thing you see is a massive wall coming straight toward you. Blast your way through it, unlock upgrades, and try to make it farther every time.

title: The Royal Restoration Society Demo
description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

title: Sekigahara 1600 Demo
description: Free demo of Sekigahara 1600. The demo includes six battlefields: Nancy, Bowang, Okehazama, Sekigahara, Gettysburg and Waterloo, plus the interactive tutorial. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game.

title: Titanhelm Demo
description: Titanhelm is a co-op base building game where you and your friends build a settlement, command a Titan and fight back the creatures of a dark and hostile forest. Gather resources, harvest Soul energy from fallen enemies and upgrade your Titan before the forest consumes you.

title: Lorenium Orbit Demo
description: LoreniumOrbit Demo is a focused first look at the game’s Custom Match experience. Battle in team-based space combat using Steam P2P matchmaking, fight alongside AI bots, capture objectives, earn Lorenium, upgrade your ship, and help shape the future of the game.

title: For Our King Demo
description: A medieval Tower Defense x Autobattler Roguelite. Defend your Keep across escalating waves, recruit different unit types, and cast spells from different Schools of Magic. Spend what you earn on a skill tree with over 300 upgrades, and place them on a Decree Bar with many unique modifiers and mults.

title: Dugout Dice Demo
description: Step up to the plate in Dugout Dice Demo! Where classic dice combos meet roguelike baseball strategy! Roll Full Houses and Four-of-a-Kinds to drive in runs, conquer innings, and build unstoppable synergy with fan boosts and careful strategy on your journey to beat the odds and win the World Series!

title: 10 Million Pixels Demo
description: Mine through a world of 50,000 pixels to find the Golden Pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

title: Beat A Boo! Demo
description: Beat A Boo is an online co-op game for up to 4 players, blending roguelike and horror with music. Run from vile creatures, destroy cursed artifacts, capture ghosts, and do the Devil’s bidding.

title: THAT BOMB GAME Demo
description: A dangerous bomb game up to 12 players where you'll have to type words fast to save yourself from exploding. Use power-up cards to control the game, only the last player standing wins.

title: TCG: Collector’s Mess Demo
description: Try the first rooms of TCG: Collector’s Mess, a cozy first-person collecting game in a house buried under trading cards. Clean up the bedroom, hall, bathroom and laundry, open packs card by card and fill your binders. Your progress carries over to the full game.

title: The Grander Demo
description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world. Learn the difference between being God and just playing.

title: A Game About Picking Fruits Demo
description: Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days? Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

title: Retro Chaos: Together Tidy Up Demo
description: A chaotic co-op organizing sim in a retro electronics store. Team up with up to 3 friends to sort thousands of CRTs, consoles and gadgets — throw, catch, stack and stock your way from total mess to the perfect shelf.

title: Desert Struggle Demo
description: Desert Struggle is a fast paced real time strategy game. It is about base building, production timing and attack waves. Units are fully automated, so there are no standing armies. It is all about production capacities, expansions and timings! Play challenges or custom matches against the AI.

title: Great Town Business: Life, Living & Luxuries Demo
description: Create your character and start living in a small town to create and improve your business while having a chance to have a relationship with all the NPC's.

title: Bloody Duke Demo
description: Embark as Blaise Vaelthorne, the 35th Duke of Caerwyn and Warden of the White City, on a harrowing journey to reclaim the Phoenix Throne from the daemon host. Endure betrayal, suffering, and impossible odds as you fight to restore your dukedom’s destiny. By Right. By Blood.

title: Bongo VPet - Taskbar Buddy Demo
description: A tiny VPet device lives on your desktop and its pixel pet hops with every key you press. Earn Bongo Points while you work, feed treats, open Bongo Boxes and hunt rare Color pets, skins and devices you can trade on Steam.

title: One More Flight Demo
description: The engines hum. The service cart rolls down the aisle. Inevitably, the plane goes down.Then the cycle begins anew.One more flight is a side-scrolling psychological horror game driven by observation, timing, and cumulative knowledge.

title: 9999+ Weapons: Idle RPG Demo
description: Lead a squad of collectible companions in an open-world idle RPG shared with other players. Summon heroes, forge better equipment, and challenge bosses as your squad grows stronger. Explore new areas, take on quests, or spend some time fishing, mining, and woodcutting.

title: Rat Quest 2: The Quest For Moon Cheese Demo
description: Rat Quest Is a difficult Platformer that requires precise movement to insure you dont die! This game is incredibly difficult the prizes along the way make it rewarding.

title: CactusBandido Demo
description: Love your friends? Too bad: in Thorn City, you're going to steal their loot. Face off with 2 to 6 players, outsmart the sheriff, and let the richest cactus win!

title: REM Demo
description: REM is an atmospheric dream exploration game. Explore surreal spaces and architecture. Collect all of the dream seeds and plant them. Every dream remembers the last one, and every dream is shaped by the garden you tend when you're awake.

title: Keycap: Tidy Up! Demo
description: A cozy organizing game where you tidy up a keyboard shop. Sort over 4,000 keycaps, snap them into place and enjoy the satisfying click of every key. Unlock abilities, organize at your own pace and even design your own keyboards!

title: CubeVerse Demo
description: A voxel space sandbox with zero loading screens. Build bases, construct vehicles, take off from your homeworld, and venture into space to explore a seamless procedural galaxy of 100+ million star systems. In CubeVerse, the sky is not the limit.

title: Crack the Bills Demo
description: Your breakfast diner is broke and the eggs won't stop coming. Aim a wooden spoon, crack eggs for coins, pay the bills before they pile up and dodge foreclosure in this crunchy, bite-sized active incremental game.

title: Dice Sort Together: Arcane Hall Demo
description: A cozy first-person tidy up and organizing simulator where you sort 4,400+ fantasy dice and tabletop pieces. Solo or online co-op with up to 4 players, restore the Arcane Hall's 9 departments through relaxing, satisfying ASMR dice sounds and magic skills - no time limit.

title: Motor Sport Unbounded Demo
description: Motor Sport Unbounded is an open-world arcade racing game inspired by the legendary street racers of the early 2000s. Explore a vast nighttime city, compete in a variety of events, upgrade your cars, challenge the Street Crown bosses, and reclaim your place at the top after a devastating betrayal.

title: Creators of War Demo
description: Creators of War is a pixel-art strategy game where you command armies, shape formations, and lead your warriors into battle. Build your forces, outmaneuver your enemies, and watch your decisions shape the battlefield. DEMO

title: Chaos of the Realms Demo
description: Chaos of the Realms is a 2D action RPG where the demigods have vanished and the Void is tearing reality apart. Fight waves, clear dungeons, craft gear, farm, tame animals, trade with NPCs, and rebuild hope across collapsing realms.

title: Duoshift Demo
description: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

title: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley Demo
description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.

title: Dark Pixel Demo
description: A stylized retro inspired platformer. Fight for creativity against an A.I. threatening your beloved art application. Use a unique collection of art tool inspired power-ups to restore colour to your worlds. A.I. is destroying art! It's time to stomp it out!

title: Scales: Exiled Girl Demo
description: Raise a girl like never before! Experience the story through anime-style storytelling in a fantasy adventure romance game that blends character development, interactive choices, free exploration, and multiple endings.

title: Blades & Trades Demo
description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

title: A Simple job 2 Demo
description: 💼 One simple task. Countless choices. But what if your job was never the real objective? 😏 Experience absurd humor, discover bizarre endings, and uncover what's really hiding behind it all.

title: M!RACLE home_page Demo
description: They quit college to become social media millionaires... Five years later, their channel has three hundred subscribers and their latest video has eighteen views... Demo of M!RACLE home_page, a psychological horror visual novel about two friends who are tired of being ignored.

title: INNER EKO Demo
description: A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of. Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

title: Block Battlefield.
description: 《方块战场 Block Battlefield》 is a light Roguelike game that combines real-time falling blocks with auto-battler combat. By clearing blocks, you can deploy soldiers, choose random upgrades, and break through enemy fortresses. Build your block army and push your limits on an ever-changing battlefield!

title: Deadhand Theater Demo
description: A dark, turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands are your weapons and your own puppet body is fair game to sacrifice. Rip off a limb for a desperate edge, refine your deck, and survive one more fight.

title: My Paper Plane is Better Demo
Nuclear Apocalypse Merchant Simulator Demo
description: Run a bunker shop in the apocalypse: resell scarce supplies, meet shifting demands, and send scavengers to restock. Keep the shelter secure as raids, shortages, and rival factions close in, obey the continuity force law. Don’t wait for the economy to shift, shape it yourself.

title: Road Truckers: New Beginning Demo
description: Start your trucking sim adventure in a massive demo without playtime limits. Explore the full countryside map in a customizable truck. Do transport jobs, meet people, and start expanding the business on your journey to fortune and greatness.

title: Wayfar: Crown's Call Demo
description: Step into a cozy tale where fate and feelings intertwineOnce, there was only the Darkness. Then the gods appeared: they drove it back, divided the lands among themselves, created the peoples… and eventually left this world behind. Their legacy lives on in the Idols—chosen warriors blessed with divine power.

title: 对我而言 Demo
description: 发生在平行宇宙，一个向命运扣动扳机的男人的故事。

title: Wayward Cosmos Demo
description: Free demo: explore four charted star systems of a seed-driven galaxy. Dogfight pirate wings, land on worlds, raid sites on foot, and build a salvaged fleet — solo or in Steam co-op. Wishlist Wayward Cosmos to unlock the rest of the galaxy when it releases.

title: Rally Shift Demo
description: Drive with a live bomb on your dashboard while a relentless alien anomaly stalks you at every turn. Rally Shift is an arcade first person rally time attack. Stay on the gas, master sharp turns, and beat your personal record before time runs out

title: Trox The Reversal Demo
description: Trox The Reversal Demo version is a first person horror game set in an alternate reality where the Cold War became a global nuclear war. With food supplies collapsing, the Soviet government introduces the Sustainable Meat Act, making cannibalism legal and forcing every household to contribute.

title: Relic Recoil Demo
description: Cute looks. Serious firepower! Join Ain and Granma in a survivor-style action game with persistent base upgrades. Blast through hordes in machine ruins with guns and drones, bring resources home, and upgrade your favorite weapons and abilities as you push deeper with every expedition.

title: CountryClicker: The very good demo
description: Click countries in CountryClicker: The best clicker game about clicking countries! Ascend, upgrade, and do it all again.

title: Counter Ducks Demo
description: An asymmetric FPP/TPP shooter with two different game modes. In PvE, hunt ducks solo or in co-op, earn money, and upgrade your gear. In PvP, switch roles and play as a duck against hunters in chaotic 4v4 battles!

title: Bacon Cannibal Demo
description: EVERYTHING IS GOOD IN THE PIG! Run your own pork restaurant, cook delicious pork recipes for your customers, expand your menu, manage your stock, grow your restaurant, and build your rind empire!

title: 迷宫：囚笼    Maze : Captivity Demo
description: A relaxing puzzle game. Combine spells and items to better traverse the maze. Through the maze trial, we shall select mages who possess both wisdom and talent. Come, contribute your strength to the nation! Seek the final exit and solve the mystery!

title: Harrowed World: Dracula Fallen Demo
description: Demo: Dracula has been resurrected in modern nights Los Angeles. Separated from his home by oceans and time itself, he must come to grips with a new world while his survival hangs in the balance.

title: Rain98 Demo
description: This is the demo version of Rain98. Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

title: The Mystery of Oak Island Demo
description: Set sail for Oak Island in a story-driven point-and-click adventure. Explore atmospheric locations, meet intriguing characters, collect clues and solve puzzles as you begin to uncover the mystery. Get a first taste of the adventure in this free demo.

title: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering Demo
description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

title: Culture Warz: Tactics Demo
description: Get a taste of Culture Warz: Tactics in this free demo! Lead your squad of Chads through turn-based tactical battles, outsmart the NPCs and protect the Jammers. Combine abilities, plan your moves and rewind your mistakes to turn tactical disasters into victories.

title: FAKE ME Demo
description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

title: Grandpa Loves Trains Demo
description: Grandpa has retired and now spends his days playing with his toy trains. With the station needing a new conductor, the responsibility falls to his grandson, Abraham. Board passengers, unlock powerful abilities through a skill tree, and expand your railway empire in this cozy incremental roguelite.

title: Jump Bald Demo
description: A metroidvania full of bald guys? Reach the top of the tower with pixel-perfect jumps, collecting weapons that let you unlock the map. Be careful! every mistake can send you, literally, back to the beginning. Only then will you be able to take revenge on the one who mocked you and your alopecia...

title: The Arrow Demo
description: The Arrow is a retro wave-based horror shooter set in a world reshaped by a religious military sect. Fight alone or with friends as you push through war‑torn ruins in a crusade to spread the one true god.

title: Grobnopolis | Last Days Demo
description: Grobnopolis is a slow, oppressive atmospheric horror experience where curiosity is both compass and curse. The sun is gone. The mines are bleeding. Walk the dying city of Huta-Grobno, tune into forbidden broadcasts and survive the last days of a world rotting under the clouds.

title: Et le grain mourut Demo
description: A visual novel set in 1920s Paris. As summer draws near, young students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them.

title: LOTH Demo
description: Drag chains of gems before the hourglass runs dry. Close a loop and everything inside erupts. Recruit ushabti, the clay servants of Egypt's dead, and stack them into an engine that turns three gems into millions. Then face the gods. One tomb. One run.

title: Skybreak Demo
description: Free demo for Skybreak. Learn the physics-driven flight model, run the practice drills, cruise the city in Free Roam, and fight AI drones in Team Deathmatch and Destroy the Base. Offline, no account needed. Online multiplayer is in the full game.

title: Too Many Animals ! Demo
description: Too Many Animals is a cozy first-person organizing game where thousands of adorable animals are mixed together. Identify each animal, sort them into the correct family, and fill every shelf as you turn complete chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

title: Leafborn Demo
description: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!

title: Wasteland Gunsmith Simulator Demo
description: A cozy post-apocalyptic gunsmith simulator where you run a traveling workshop from the back of your camper. Craft, repair, restore, and customize unique weapons from scavenged junk while serving settlers, mercenaries, and gangs across the wasteland.

title: Riftmoor Demo
description: A colony sim plus dungeon crawler where you build a thriving settlement, manage your citizens, create a powerful army, venture through mysterious rifts into dangerous dungeons, and return with the resources needed to grow your kingdom.

title: Stars of Icarus Demo
description: From the creators of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Form your team and pilot, repair, and man the guns on your ship. Victory or death, together.

title: Chill Rogues Demo
description: Chill Rogues is an incremental action game with automatic combat, build crafting, and ongoing prestige.

title: Apprentice Mage Gale Demo
description: Apprentice Mage Gale is an Autobattler RPG where your entire party depends on you. You are their ONLY damage dealer, so master 16 spells, build your mage through 100+ skill nodes, overcome monsters and bosses, and fight across eight lands on the road to the Demon Lord.

title: The Beaten Track Demo
description: This free demo of [b]The Beaten Track[/b] takes you to a single island: some 20 km² of land with nothing but sea around it. It's the same island for everyone, and you share it with every other driver playing the demo.

title: No Body No Problem! Demo
description: Get your first taste of chaos in No Body, No Problem! Demo. One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, and try to get away with the perfect crime before the police uncover the truth.

title: Cozy Airways Demo
description: Try the free demo of Cozy Airways — the tycoon that feels like a warm hug. Open your first routes across a storybook world, win loyal travellers, and grow a tiny airline at your own gentle pace with your friendly co-pilot Sky. Then wishlist the full game!

title: Fall of the Void Demo
description: Experience the dark isometric ARPG action of Fall of the Void in this official demo. Descend into treacherous dungeons, master fast-paced combat and evolving abilities, unlock deep skill synergies, and face brutal Void monstrosities.

title: Soul Hunter Demo
description: A 1-4 player co-op psychological horror where your camera lens is your only charm. Exorcise evil spirits, dispel illusions, and seal cursed souls onto film before they claim yours.

title: Diversion Demo
description: Process defective products through the Advanced Observation System, harvest energy, and upgrade your operation to meet rising quotas. Explore a deeper mystery beyond your workstation, where failure has consequences and the company isn't quite what it seems.

title: Ragnarok Roads Demo
description: Lead a convoy across post-nuclear Scandinavia in 1986. Scavenge irradiated ruins, recruit survivors, and fight tactical vehicle battles on frozen roads. This is a retro-style strategy game, rewarding the planning, perceptive and persistent players, like games used to be.

title: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler Demo
UNDERDEEP / アンダーディープ Demo
description: This demo lets you play the opening portion of UNDERDEEP. Some content and features from the full version are not included.

title: Project MAGNUM Demo
description: Take control of the M1A5 MAGNUM. Fight mechs, drones, robots, and enemy tanks across ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and abandoned battlefields. Explore a hostile world and customize your tank with a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins.

title: Separator Demo
description: «Separator» is a short nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, inspired by modern occultism and beliefs surrounding mysticism.

title: Midnight Flare Demo
description: Midnight Flare is a multi episode point-and-click puzzle adventure. In this demo you explore a house in a town drowned in an eerie red glow, rummaging through objects, unlocking mechanisms, and dealing with strange characters. Can you solve the mystery of this strange house?

title: UnderForged Demo
description: UnderForged is a chaotic co-op crafting game where you play as a team of dwarven blacksmiths. Mine, smelt, and forge raw iron into legendary equipment. Expand your workshop, upgrade your tools, and most importantly fulfil your contracts. Inspired by PlateUp! and OverCooked with a Rogue-Like Twist!

title: Where the Seeds Fall Demo
description: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

title: Arcadice Demo
description: Load dice as bullets. Shoot d-heads. Survive the arcade machine that wants you dead.

title: I Made This Game in 1 Year - without AI Demo
One Million Skeletons Demo
description: The dead are coming, thousands at a time. Build a Gothic fortress of ramparts, ballistae and bombards and hold it for nine nights. Every skeleton you break leaves bones behind: grind them into crowns, load them as ammunition, or watch the pile become a ramp over your walls.

title: 28 Days Train Wreck Survivor Demo
description: A hardcore first-person survival simulator. Explore a wrecked freight train, loot containers, hunt, gather resources, craft weapons and gear, and manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and warmth to make it through 28 days of cold and predators.

title: 霊障観測シ Demo
description: An abandoned fusion mansion, "The Inumaki Estate." Dive into this 1st-person paranormal investigation horror. As a cursed-property investigator, use advanced devices to record phenomena into digital data, pinpointing coordinates for exorcism. Survive until 6 AM. Can you document the truth?

title: Crystalysis Demo
description: Try Crystalysis for free, a fast-paced slingshot roguelite. Pull the ball back, let go, and it ricochets through enemies: the faster it goes, the harder it hits. Each run lasts ten minutes, and you hold off the waves attacking your crystal until the boss arrives. Play as many as you like.

title: Cielvia-Inherited By Defeat- Demo
description: Experience the opening of Cielvia - Inherited by Defeat -. Switch between Light and Dark combat styles, turn defeat into strength by extracting enemy abilities, and challenge your foes again. Play through the entire first stage, including its boss battle.

title: Boss in Diapers Demo
description: Boss in Diapers is a competitive card game set in a chaotic daycare! Defeat your rivals to sit on the Boss Chair. Create your Baby Mafia Boss and battle with 2–4 players to rule the daycare.

title: Abyssal Lapidary Demo
description: A Victorian workshop management sim where you inherit the fading Vermilion House in the underground city of Fathomholm. Appraise rawstones, cut gems, design jewelry, rebuild your shop's reputation, and uncover the horrors buried deep beneath the strata.

title: Rind Town Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every customer’s order is a puzzle. Build the right juice from up to five ingredient cards, blend it, and chase scores that grow until they stop fitting on screen. Become the juice master of an anime town.

title: Archrebel Tactics Demo
description: Archrebel is a sci-fi, turn-based strategy war game, strongly inspired by the classic Rebelstar, released in 1986. In Archrebel, players control several dozen units on a grid-based map, performing actions limited by a classic action-point system similar to those found in Laser Squad and UFO: Enemy Unknown.

title: Fenestra: my focus, her future Demo
Launch Hazard Demo
description: Launch Hazard is a single-player physics score attack game. Send a rocket-powered athlete crashing through arenas, steer mid-crash to chain targets, and complete objectives to score higher and earn better ranks in 90-second runs.

title: Nether Abyss Demo
description: Scale the doomed Nether Abyss to leap into the Well of Reincarnation. In this dark Chinese Action-Roguelite with Extraction mechanics, rise as a nameless undead from the blood pools. Scavenge the fallen, endure cycles of rebirth, slay ancient demons, and draw your blade against heaven as you climb.

title: Method in the Witchness Demo
description: Demo: A cozy game of sorting, riddles, and puzzles on a little witch’s table. Arrange magical objects, discover hidden secrets that may help in later puzzles, and uncover a gentle story—one uniquely sounding item at a time.

title: Vlad Voievod Dracula The Crusaders Tomb Demo
description: A Classicvania action-horror game where you play as Vlad Tepes Dracula, the medieval Voievod (Warlord) of Wallachia. Fight your way through the Cesme Castele to recruit a great warrior held by the Genovese in the place called The Crusaders Tomb

title: Zero Survivors: The Hero Must Die Demo
Faintlight Traveler : Whisper Demo
description: 輕鬆休閒放置RPG。透過採集﹑戰鬥獲得素材來打造你的裝備，挑戰更強的魔物，創造自己的冒險故事。

title: UNDERSTAR: Dig Below, Rise Above Demo
description: Explore a sample of UNDERSTAR's 2D mining world. Dig through a destructible underground, carve routes, and gather resources as you discover what waits below the settlement. This single-player demo introduces the full game's core idea.

title: Whale Life Simulator Demo
description: Experience the life of a whale. Hit the streets, earn cash, and pour massive amounts of money into an online game. Use your maxed-out account to crush other players! In this demo, you can experience the first week of your life as a whale.

title: Animals League Unite Demo
description: Play the whole first world: 10 Meadow levels for 2 to 8 players, on one screen or online. Stack up, shout, fall together, then make your own levels in the level editor.

title: Harbor of Vows Demo
description: A comforting and heartfelt Visual Novel about a young musician struggling to write a simple song. Roki Olsen seems to want nothing more than to sing on stage…truly, when he looks at Elly Hammington, we think he might be lying.

title: Empty House Demo
description: Online co-op survival horror for up to 4 players. Mimic the zombies, roam abandoned houses, recover vaccines, and get back to the bus. Zombies can't tell a mimic from their own, but many kinds will stand in your way. Gear up, work together, and meet your quota, or it all ends there.

title: ZomBMart Demo
description: ZomBMart is a couch co-opetition game where the chaos of a casual supermarket job meets the zombie apocalypse. 1-4 players clock in to their casual job, compete and cooperate to complete tasks and make sure all customers are satisfied (especially the undead ones).

title: Mischief Motors Demo
description: Mischief Motors is a chaotic couch multiplayer car combat game where cartoony vehicles, over-the-top special weapons, and destructible arenas turn every match into explosive cartoon mayhem. Pick your ride, wreck your friends, and survive the battle.

title: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.) Demo
description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

title: SUBLIMEAL Demo
