description: As an Octochef, master your typing skills to manage and serve dishes in a conveyor belt restaurant. Type to cook, type to upgrade, type to automate in Typopus, an incremental cooking game. Satisfy customers, unlock new meals and optimize your restaurant.

title: Kaizen Kitchen: A Restaurant Simulator Demo
description: Open a restaurant in the heart of a cozy little Japanese town. Cook authentic Japanese dishes, serve hungry customers, and experience the first taste of running your own restaurant!

title: ASUKA x Redline Reverie Demo
description: Play as Asuka Sakai and take on the mountain roads of Japan. Tune your car, challenge rival racers, climb the rankings, and earn your place at GRACE. A pure touge racing experience.

title: Handle With Care Demo
description: Handle With Care is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

title: Idle Reef Demo
description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

title: Cash Only Demo
description: Run a coffee shop by day and a drug business on the side. Serve customers, grow product, negotiate dead drops, avoid the cops, and split the work with friends in this co-op crime simulator.

title: Dice Knight Demo
description: Dice knight is a dice builder rouge like. Roll for numbers and use those numbers on different actions. Discover food items of power, and become the Dice Knight!

title: University of Progress Demo
description: Fully voiced, choice-driven Visual Novel. Instead of playing as a boring guy who is designed to be compatible with everyone, what if you played as an abrasive young man who isn't compatible with anyone and usually ends up making things worse? Meet Millard. He's kind of a dickhead.

title: ISKRA Demo
description: You take on the role of Alice, who wanders through a dark forest in search of a way out. On her journey she meets many figures — each one a reflection of her own personality, an echo of her fears, and a manifestation of her subconscious.

title: Here Comes the Horde Demo
description: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Play this demo for the taste of the full experience and try yourself out in the first 7 levels of the game.

title: Plague Lords Demo
description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

title: STARHOME Demo
description: Take command of a fleet carrying the last survivors of your civilization. Manage limited space aboard your ships, balance living quarters, production, defenses, and weapons, and explore an unknown galaxy in search of a new home. Play the STARHOME Demo.

title: Squabblin Goblins Demo
description: A chaotic multiplayer deckbuilding PvP with GOBLINS. Grab items, throw them at your friends, and craft a goblin so broken your friends will hate you.
developer: André Correia, Isaac Cerejo, Manyllines, Pedro Brito, João Santos, Rita Moutinho

title: Taptown Funk Demo
description: Taptown Funk is a groovy incremental rhythm game about growing a tiny funky town into a booming city. Hover to build, tap to the beat, catch coin combos & feel the heat. When the music stops, disaster detonates. Upgrade, rebuild or just automate! Can you find the groove, or will Taptown Funk you up?

title: Playrooms Demo
description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

title: Benny's Backrooms Demo
description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

title: Korean Noodle House Demo
description: A Singleplayer cooking experience. Exploring Korean cooking recipes and culture in a cozy environment. Make customers happy with delicious dishes, gain experience and level up, earn achievements and discover pieces in the art gallery!

title: Coma Dreams Demo
description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

title: Oh! my Table Demo
description: Become the ultimate food artist in Oh! my Table. This relaxing sandbox game lets you design mouth watering dishes, mix and match tableware, and master the art of sauce drizzling. Use the Camera Mode to capture and share your delicious masterpieces.

title: Deathly Delights Demo
description: Forge new friendships, banish the darkness, and illuminate your surroundings as you unravel the mysteries behind a town stuck in limbo during Hallows Eve.

title: Foundering Demo
description: A chat app you've never seen before appears on your desktop. The moment you open it, a girl in strange work clothes asks for your help. After a brief time together, another world begins to unfold through that little chat window.

title: Little Warrior Demo
description: The Tiny Warrior demo features early-game content, allowing players to experience the core combat, character progression, and level-based gameplay. Demo content may differ from the final release.

title: Sort On The Ball Demo
description: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

title: PARRY IT Demo
description: A fast-paced 2D minimalist action platformer where every attack can be parried with precise timing.

title: ArkSeed Terraformery Demo
description: You are the last chance for humanity, Terraform, Build, Save Humanity one pixel at a time.

title: Too Much Baggage Demo
description: Ever wonder where your bags go after check-in? In Too Much Baggage, keeping the airport moving is your problem. Build and expand a network of belts, route bags through security, and adapt as your airport grows. How long can you keep the world’s baggage flowing?

title: Grid & Guilt Demo
description: A unique 7x7 grid-based turn-based puzzle roguelike! Defeating monsters spawns lava, and collecting items spawns spike traps on the next floor. Climb the tower of 'Guilt' with 4 unique classes where your own choices shape the dangerous terrain ahead!

title: Space Travelers Demo
description: Mine asteroids, trade minerals and explore the opening sectors of a relaxed 2D space sim, then pin it to your desktop as a live wallpaper. The demo covers the game's first act with no time limit, and your save carries over to the full game.

title: COOKBOT prelude
description: You've been placed as a standard pantry model COOKBOT on the pioneer ship Ruya. Your systems are malfunctioning. Cook, bake and pour while following recipes. The crew might talk to you. This is expected. Don't listen to them - you are just a machine. This is a demo for COOKBOT.

title: Depth Above Demo
description: An atmospheric horror game inspired by classics from the 2000s. Playing as William in his constant search for Lynn, he ventures into all kinds of obscure places. With Lynn's last note as a guide, his goal remains, taking him through many places with creatures and environments shaped by corruption.

title: Eulogy of an Insect Demo
description: Explore the first two puzzle-box dungeons of this hand-drawn RPG with reactive turn-based combat, where bizarre characters each play differently. In search of her father, Charlie has found herself in a world of surreal wonder and BUGS. Finding him is one thing. Leaving is another...

title: What a Shift! Demo
description: Manage a chaotic fast-food joint in this arcade roguelite! Stack trays, serve hungry queues, draft game-changing upgrade cards, and survive intense Rush Hours. Can you make it to the end of the shift?

title: Cardboard Gladiators Demo
description: Build a crew, forge powerful items and discover game-breaking synergies in this PvPvE inventory-management autobattler. Try Act 1 with five gladiators, plan fully automatic battles and face other players’ teams through asynchronous PvP.

title: Pioneer Venture: Echo Demo
description: Pilot your ship, master inertia, and turn the tide amid heavy enemy fire with Extreme Dodge and up to 6 active abilities. Grow stronger through consecutive battles in Survival Mode, or collect ships, upgrade gear, and uncover the universe’s past and hidden truths in Story Mode.

title: Burger Smash Demo
description: Try the first map of Burger Smash: 5 City levels of fast-paced single-player cooking. Plan your kitchen, grill burgers, keep orders flowing, and unlock upgrades at Burger College. More zones, levels and characters are coming in the full game.

title: Victory Banner Demo
description: Victory Banner Demo is a fast-paced real-time strategy game where you can command entire squads or take direct control of individual soldiers, vehicles, and tanks.

title: A Game About a King Saving a Dragon Demo
description: Help a mighty dragon restore its power in this relaxing incremental game. Gather resources, summon workers, construct buildings, and unlock powerful upgrades as you progress.

title: Pizzapoly Demo
description: PIZZAPOLY Demo is a chaotic co-op restaurant game where you run your own pizzeria with friends. Prepare pizzas, serve tables, handle online orders, hop on your scooter for deliveries, and survive the rush together.

title: BrouHaHa Demo
description: Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

title: Maré Demo
description: In a relaxing open world, fish and explore at your own pace. Sell the fish you catch, invest in upgrades for your boat, and discover new areas with more valuable species. The farther you go, the more surprises the ocean reveals.

title: The Rifted Skies Demo
description: The Rifted Skies is an active VR parkour set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Fight, fall and come back stronger to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover the truth: can your home ever be saved?

title: Co-Ed Casualty: A Chandler Chase Case Demo
description: Spring break at Briarwood College turns lethal when a student is found dead on campus. Journalism major Chandler Chase finds himself caught in a murder investigation he never asked to be part of. Interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, and unravel a conspiracy someone is desperate to keep hidden.

title: Liminal Angel Demo
description: Demons have possessed the wildlife, turning animals against humanity. As an angel in human form, you must prepare for a perilous journey. Meet the survivors without revealing your true identity, gather your gear, and evade demon-possessed beasts before dawn breaks. (Roguelike)

title: Pan, Please! Demo
description: Grab. Sizzle on the beat. Serve. Pay the bills. A rhythm cooking roguelite where one frying pan is all that stands between your failing diner and bankruptcy. Mouse only, flips itself on the beat, and the rent is due on Thursday.

title: Astrocraft Demo
description: Try Astrocraft for free. Mine asteroids, build your station room by room, open a shop for space travelers, and assemble a robot crew to automate it all, solo or in co-op for up to four players. Wishlist the full game for the Pilot Bot, station defense, human workers, and more.

title: A Game About Shooting Targets Demo
description: Complete challenging missions across diverse shooting ranges, build your custom arsenal with unique weapons and attachments and defeat all blacklist members in order to take your place in the most prestigious squad of the army in this Demo about A Game About Shooting Targets!

title: SAM Arena Demo
description: Collect, escape and hunt in a strategic rock-paper-scissors styled arena battler, where each player gains abilities based on their equipped masks.

title: Bless You Again Demo
description: Lily is a magician and a homunculus who braves a perilous dungeon in search of the Philosopher's Stone. Control a character faithfully reproduced from cel animation and defeat countless monsters in pursuit of powerful blessings. Use blessings, skills, and gimmicks to forge a strength of your own!

title: Rig the Casino Demo
description: The house always wins. So stop playing fair — RIG IT. ROGUELIKE LUCK-ENGINE BUILDER where you GAMBLE, CHOOSE UPGRADES, and RIG THE CASINO.

title: Forgotten Tavern Demo
description: Run a tavern simulation set in a hidden Korean mountain village. Gather ingredients through unpredictable weather, discover traditional Korean recipes, and serve mystical Dokkaebi and villagers. Get to know your guests by discovering their favourite dishes and unique preferences.

title: Sector Zero: Freedom Demo
description: A sci-fi incremental simulation where you work as an Imperial slave, build your own business, survive inspections, join unions, and buy your freedom.

title: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set! Demo
description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.

title: Working with Montabi Demo
description: Let adorable Montabi keep you company while you work! A desktop companion that types together with you. Customize your room and avatar, stay focused with productivity tools, and collect every Montabi by placing their favorite items!

title: Neon Armada - Solar Storm Demo
description: A top-down arena roguelite you can learn in one wave and spend a hundred hours mastering. Waves close in from every edge; the shop between them decides what you become. 32 ships, 28 weapons, 115 mods to combine — then endless mode, where the caps come off.

title: The Sixth Sin Demo
description: In 1996, thirty-two children died in their beds at an orphanage. Thirty years later, Stephen walks back through that door. Six of the seven seals are broken — and the voice guiding you is one of them. Manage your inventory, finish the rituals, never let go of the light.

title: The Attic: A Mystery Puzzle Game Demo
Unwanted Guest Demo
description: Unwanted Guest is a first-person survival horror game where players explore a haunted mansion, solve environmental and painting-based puzzles, evade a relentless ghost, and uncover the mystery behind the mansion while searching for a way to escape alive.

title: GRAVHOUNDS Demo
description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

title: Geolocation Case Files: Road Trip to Robert's Grave Demo
description: A story intertwined with a modern-day road trip. By identifying dashcam photos, you will reconstruct the route and learn about people and places. A real trip and a real geolocation.

title: All Rats on Deck Demo
description: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

title: Wolf Plot Demo
description: Wolf Plot is a tricky puzzle-platformer. Help your wolves catch the sheep in over 100 levels. Use a variety of tools to control your wolves: rockets, fans, bombs, bridges, and more.

title: Inpulse Demo
description: Ammo is Movement. Do-Re-Mi is your moveset. You are Flute, a shapeshifting creature who plays music to move. Collect Notes to form melodies and fire them outwards to move through the air. A kaizo-inspired platformer that wants you to succeed, from long-time veterans of the genre.

title: The Corner's BigYear
description: A desktop idle bird‑watching game. Play passively or take manual control. Fill out your bird field guide and climb the ranks in the Big Year competition. Light‑hearted and low‑time‑commitment, it sits neatly on your desktop. Just click now and then for a nice casual break.

title: 弹珠之王 Demo
description: Four chapters. Twenty stages.Pull the spring plunger, send your ball through the pegboard, and reach the target score with a limited supply of balls. Pinball King Demo includes the city tournament, provincial team selection, provincial tournament, and national training camp selection: 4 chapters and 20 stages, ending after the camp...

title: Network Engineer Demo
description: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

title: SPIN HEROES: Paths of Evolution DEMO
description: Spin! Change Classes! Super Evolution! A new kind of Action Rogue RPG game. Build your team, choose your classes, and create the strongest combo damage! Defeat the evil final boss and save this world!

title: Raid Leader Simulator Demo
description: Try the free demo of Raid Leader Simulator, featuring item levels 500–750. Recruit and develop raiders, build a balanced lineup, manage morale and loot, prepare tactics, and experience the core fantasy guild-management and tactical boss-encounter loop.

title: ガッチャ！サバイバー Demo
SoundRelay Demo
description: Try SoundRelay for free. The demo is the full soundboard with the same audio quality, editor and recorder, limited to 8 clips at a time and 3 hotkeys. Everything you set up carries over to the full version on the same computer.

title: Piast Demo
description: Piast RTS Demo Challenge: Can you build the Stronghold in 15 minutes? Gather resources, manage your workers, trade at the marketplace, and survive Duke Popiel’s demands.

title: Criminal Archives: Symphony of Death Collector's Edition Demo
description: A staged accident. A stolen symphony. A killer keeping perfect time. Uncover the truth behind the opera house's deadliest performance in this gripping Hidden Object mystery.

title: Massively Singleplayer Demo
description: A predatorily monetized MMO turned singleplayer action roguelite. Choose your class and face six biomes filled with hordes of monsters. You have 20 minutes before the servers shut down, survive the onslaught or get banned. Gamble your way to glory and pay some guy in a bush to bless you.

title: The Big Cleanup: Hotel Palm Beach Demo
description: A physics-driven cleanup simulator. Put 1,000+ scattered objects where they belong using physics and your trusty van. Decorate however you want. Throw it. Organize it. Clean it. Help your aunt clean up this mess! Oh, and there’s a chicken. A very grumpy one.

title: Nullwatch Demo
description: Hold your base against waves of geometric nodes in this stationary shooter. Aim, choose what gets deleted first and time every reload. Between nights, upgrade your base, sell salvage, buy better guns and spend skill points before the field fills again.

title: BugFactory Demo
description: Build, automate and scale a software factory. Move bugs through Reproduce, Fix, Test and Deploy, eliminate bottlenecks, survive regressions and turn a manual pipeline into an increasingly powerful automated system.

title: Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter Demo
Our Church and Halloween RPG Demo
Maneki Mania Demo
description: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

title: Your Reputation Precedes You Demo
description: In this incremental game you Gain reputation with 3 different morality factions; Good, neutral, and Evil. Doing quests boosting levels, rewards, and Reputation. The friends you make along the way, help by gaining favor for more quest. More level ups more loot! Pump those Reps for more Reputation.

title: Desktop Ramen Tycoon Demo
description: Enjoy managing a cozy cat-run ramen shop right at the bottom of your desktop! Serve up delicious noodles, upgrade your equipment, and expand your feline business—all while you chill, study, or focus on your real-life work.

title: Genesis: Blue vein Demo
description: A world of fun begins with a single click. Genesis: Bluevein is a clicker game where you gather resources and take on minigames in a pixel-art world. Enjoy different ways to play with simple clicks, and discover a variety of experiences packed into tiny pixels.

title: House Of Echoes Demo
description: Its eyes are piercing into your soul from the darkness with ever growing anger. It won't leave you alone until you solve the puzzles and uncover your traumatic past. Can you work out all of the unique puzzles and find out what happened before it all fades into nothingness?

title: SHROOMY ISLAND Demo
description: Shroomy Island is a desktop tower defense idle game. Critters automatically gather, craft, build, and patrol, help them run their village and fend off the evil mushroom monsters. Slowly expand and decorate your village, and collect different critters to keep you company while you work or study!

title: Pig King Demo
description: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.

title: Curse Of Gutterdeep Demo
description: Slaughter your way through hordes of enemies. Fight alone, or with up to 4 players co-op. Complete dungeons and other missions to earn your place next to the king's throne. Upgrade your gear with the loot you bring from the missions, if you make it back that is...

title: ハムスタイピング！ Demo
1 Bit Chaos Demo
description: Trapped inside an old CRT TV, hundreds of ruthless creatures are rushing at you! Start praying to level up, power up with random cards, and die a lot. Spend your gold on new weapons and tiny companions, then try again. Death has never been this profitable!

title: Homeguard Demo
description: A casual strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

title: RunnersCatchers Demo
description: Get ready for a fast-paced, chaotic tag game for up to 8 players! Dash through obstacle courses packed with giant donuts and candy hazards. Evade your friends as a Runner, or hunt them down as a Catcher. Run. Jump. Catch. Escape.

title: Pay or Die: Cartel Simulator Demo
CartWare Demo
description: An incremental game where you go from a single-product online store up to global e-commerce domination. Manage your inventory, fulfill and ship customer orders, deal with suppliers, and expand your storefront across a retro desktop operating system, and become the world's #1 online retailer.

title: 美少女的裙下不只有连裤袜！ Demo
Tidy Tech Demo
description: Bring a cluttered tech shop back to life, one gadget at a time. Try the opening Stockroom and Peripheral Plaza, sort scattered gear into place, and enjoy a little company from BLIP in this relaxed taste of Tidy Tech.

title: Line & Lode Demo
description: Play the first region of this mining roguelite. Cast the swinging claw, manage chain tension across eight claims, choose workshop upgrades and routes, meet regional hazards, and face the Iron Warden before the demo ends.

title: Flingkeep Demo
description: Grab enemies and fling them across the battlefield in this darkly comic physics action demo. Fight through 15 Cinder March sieges, choose upgrades between battles, face the first tyrant, and return to the replayable Chaos Arena.

title: The Last Manifest Demo
description: Explore a ghostly spaceship in this cooperative sci-fi horror! Repair the ship, collect vital components, and avoid lurking creatures. Uncover the mystery of your mission before the ship consumes you entirely.

title: VoidFire Demo
description: VoidFire Demo is a dark horror shooter with fast-paced skirmish deathmatch combat, where fear and adrenaline collide.

title: Wealth of Nations: Economic Strategy Demo
My Little Kitchen Demo
description: Run a cozy little kitchen as Mallow, a sheep chef. Prepare customer orders step by step: collect ingredients, wash, chop, cook, and pack each meal for delivery before time runs out.

title: UMBRATIO - THE ODDS ARE FIXED Demo
白銀のユークロニア Demo
description: ”Silver Eucronia” is an exploration RPG where you wander through a post-apocalyptic world covered in white. Through interactions with allies, world exploration, and deadly battles against threats, you will witness the conclusion of your own world and carve out the future beyond.

title: Anxiety Mori Demo
description: A short first person horror game about dealing with anxiety that is caused by personal trauma in the past. All the past trauma just kept coming back to the present that it blurs between what is real and what is not, How deep will you be falling into the darkness.

title: 修勾逃生搜打撤 Demo
description: **Dog Escape: Extraction Shooter** A cute meme‑themed top‑down shooter‑survival game. Step into the paws of a brave pup, scavenge for supplies amid hostile forces and colossal bosses. Hunt for rare loot, upgrade your gear, craft high‑tier weapons, and grow from a nobody into a formidable fighter.

title: Zifir Demo
description: Explore the opening chapter of Zifir, a turn-based card dungeon crawler. Descend through 30 floors as the Warden, chain supplies and forge stronger equipment while hunger, stress and a fading torch test your survival.

title: Commander, Millions of Undead Are Heading Our Way Demo
一发收工 Crystal Ricochet Demo
description: Aim one ball, unravel a route, and ignite a crystal chain reaction. Explore 100 puzzle rooms built around reflections, prisms, keys and portals. Free forever, with no in-app purchases.

title: Akgwi Slash Demo
description: Endless hordes of ghosts swarming in. Become a Joseon exorcist, ride the 'Geogugoe,' and shout, 'Sleep the vengeful spirits. Slay the evil spirits!'

title: SNAPTIC Demo
description: SNAPTIC is a retro 3D platformer featuring physics-based puzzles and platforming, implementing unique mechanics such as magnetization and Anon's surreptitious ability to turn himself into a marble.

title: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven? Demo
description: In a single night, your father's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Build up your power base by brewing the best drinks and retaking the town... or, you know, by kneecapping the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

title: Parasite Core Demo
description: Buy time to harvest resources in this incremental tower defense game where you defend your core from the native species that want you off their home! Play actively and unleash your abilities, or idle and let your turrets take care of the pests.

title: Wardwell Demo
description: 《Wardwell》试玩版包含游戏开篇区域，玩家可以体验核心探索、解谜与叙事玩法。试玩版内容仅代表开发中的部分体验，部分功能与内容将在正式版中提供。  流程10-15分钟，目前已开放井鸣事件x2，传承开放到功德留名，镇物类型x3，目前仅支持中文

title: 释魂日志 Demo
description: 公司大楼里，只有你能听见死者的声音。白天当牛做马，夜里替五个鬼找回记忆——14天倒计时开始，每一个选择，都将由你亲手裁决。

title: BuzztteVTuber: Go Viral in 2018?!
description: Time-leap back to 2018 and restart your VTuber career from zero. Fifty-three weeks to go viral. Pull in your own avatar through the OBS / VTube Studio virtual camera and watch yourself stream inside the game. Miss a goal and time rewinds — your skills stay in your muscle memory, run after run.

title: Thunder Arrow: Arcade Demo
description: Pilot the HX-21 “Thunder Arrow” prototype and relive the intensity of 1980s arcades in a modern tribute to classics like After Burner and Thunder Blade.

title: Somewhere Else Demo
description: A 2-player co-op puzzle-platformer. Chimp and Chip explore space and the jungle, pull levers and ropes together, unlock new abilities and face the Flea King. Neither of them can get through alone. Play locally or online with Steam Remote Play Together.

title: Coins Must Be Made Demo
description: The king demands taxes. Try the Coins Must Be Made demo: crush goblins with your magical stamp, collect coins, and balance upgrades against the next tax payment. Get a first taste of this active incremental roguelite.

title: PANEMA Demo
description: Roll, Score and Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of cartridges, challenges and Yahtzee.

title: RUNTIME Demo
description: Dash through refill chains, flip gravity and slip past lasers in RUNTIME, a precision platformer. Play four selected chapters and race a friend on two courses, with previews of the full game’s Time Trials, level editor and cosmetic collection.

title: Despiry Demo
description: Despiry is a top-down sci-fi roguelite for 1 to 4 players with ARPG-style loot and run-based builds. Explore a hostile alien world, fight swarms, stack relics and passives, and bring back materials for permanent upgrades. There's no end to reach, only how far you go before enemies outgrow you.

title: Beneath Europa Demo
description: Dive into the eerie depths of Europa to find extraterrestrial life. Are you ready to take the next step?

title: Infinite Night 2 Demo
description: Experience the knight Kael's first battle for free. Face a swarm of enemies on the first stage, dodge their attacks, and stand against the boss in this Infinite Night 2 demo.

title: Sunny Orchard Demo
description: Run your own sunny fruit orchard! 🍇 Grow, harvest, and package fresh produce, complete orders for friendly customers, and upgrade your farm with new crops, tools, and decorations. Collect all cute premium fruit stickers to show your customers the quality and care of your fancy produce.

title: Hot Seat Triage Demo
description: Triage is easy until your own brain starts lying to you. Pick patients from a crowded ER, question them under time pressure, and call NOW, SOON or WAIT before their aura fades. Every case hides a cognitive bias built to fool you. Made by an emergency physician.

title: Cozy Associations Demo
description: Settle in with a cozy card-sorting puzzle: spot connections, gather little collections, and make yourself at home. The first two chapters, featuring 20 playable levels. A gentle tutorial and 12 interface languages are included.

title: . . kill ´em all ! Demo
description: A dark psychological FPS that pulls the protagonist through a hostile industrial maze of close-quarters combat and stalking patrols, guided by an AI whose influence blurs the lines between help, manipulation, and truth.

title: Beat Ten Demo
description: Across the Rhythm Multiverse, anomalies are disrupting the Beat. Your mission: repair the Beat, one punch at a time. Welcome to Beat Ten.

title: Mavora Demo
description: The harbour is down the road. How you get there is up to you. Take the coastal road or turn past the market in this free Mavora demo. Try a little slide through a bend, stop to watch the boats, and bring a sea-blue finish back to your garage.

title: Tipsy Corpse Demo
description: Zombies, monsters and demonic creatures have taken over the town. Someone has to deal with it. A twin-stick rogue-lite where your weapons, your cocktails and the environment can become your allies; as well as the friend sitting next to you who won't settle for just watching!

title: Shogi: Magic & Mischief Demo
description: The demo includes everything currently in the game: 17 characters, fog shogi, rule-bending spells, point-budget setups, the Workshop, and online play. The full release will add more characters and modes.

title: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts Demo
description: A 1–4 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

title: Memory Dive: An 3xscape Game — Chapter One Demo
description: You exist. You don't know why. You don't know where you came from. You are in a strange space where nothing is stable, two voices are talking to you, and that is all you know. So you do as they say. The first room of Memory Dive, complete — from the first object to the door.

title: DreamPair desktop Demo
description: A desktop companion for character lovers and OC creators.  Create your own cute pair with custom parts. Support for up to 30 pairs! Watch them talk, move, and hang out right on your screen. Stay focused with your pair in Focus Mode, and share your creations with friends!

title: Wishknot Demo
description: Rope swing down an endless wishing well. Uncover secrets and survive long enough to reclaim what is lost. A physics-driven action roguelite built for precision, improvisation and movement bliss. Swing for speed, anchor anything, tow the heavy, tangle the hostile and turn raw momentum into mastery.

title: Waveguard Demo
description: A roguelike tower defense where every run reshapes your strategy. Build your team of towers, combine more than 80 artifacts, and explore a pixel-art world while taking on ever tougher challenges and bosses.

title: Tidy Pills Demo
description: Step behind the counter of a quiet little pharmacy and bring order to its shelves. Sort, stack and arrange medicines one box at a time in this cozy organizing game. No timers, no pressure, just the simple joy of a perfectly tidy shelf.

title: The Cup Demo
description: The demo of The Cup, a free-to-play 1v1 creature card battler where everyone watches the die. Play THE ROAD, five authored bouts against invasive species, learn the game from the booth in one tutorial match, then take on the House as often as you like. Plays fully offline.

title: Rise Of The General Demo
description: Begin as an ordinary conscript in Warring States China. Shape your soldier through choices, relationships, and training, then fight in turn-based 5v5 battles and battlefield duels as you take your first steps toward military command.

title: Cake & Bake Demo
description: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.

title: TRONADO Demo
description: Cause chaos as a kid or keep the house under control as Dad in INFERKIDS. Collect candy, escape the monster, and rescue your friends in SCREAMKIDS. Discover TRONADO's asymmetric party gameplay online with 2-10 players, in split-screen, or solo with bots.

title: Calc and Beat Demo
description: “Calc and Beat” is a roguelike puzzle game where you must anticipate future developments—much like the “lethal calculation” mechanic in card games—to determine the best move. Use items strategically to protect the golem and conquer randomly generated dungeons!

title: 轮回小队 Demo
description: An "Infinite Genre" style game. Enter diverse worlds—featuring zombies, fantasy, martial arts, and more—either solo or with friends, then return to the "Main God" hub. Experiment with every imaginable ability.

title: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! Demo
description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

title: Fish on the Floor Demo
description: The fish are on the floor! Scoop, carry and toss slippery sea creatures back into their tanks in this first-person aquarium cleanup demo. Unlock upgrades, try different tools and see how many creatures you can rescue.

title: 16 Bit Gold Demo
description: Build a cozy gold mining business from the ground up. Find as much gold as you can and transform an overgrown plot of land into a thriving mining operation - one gold bar at a time.

title: Vacancy: Hotel Inspection Simulator Demo
description: Inspect hotel rooms, photograph hidden faults and decide whether the next guest can check in. Discover bizarre guest belongings, unsettling clues and hidden trophies in this first-person hotel inspection demo.

title: Three Lambs Demo
description: Three Lambs is a dark, cinematic first-person detective thriller set in Prague. Investigate crime scenes, search for hidden clues, examine evidence, question suspects, and uncover a mysterious case connected to Detective Kale's past.

title: Endless Dark Loot Demo
description: Endless Dark Loot is a dark-fantasy card-style RPG all about the thrill of the loot. Dive into dungeon after dungeon, fight hordes of demons, and grab tons of gear and skills along the way. Every run is a fresh adventure — and every drop could flip your whole strategy on its head.

title: Fuel & Steel Demo
description: This demo contains the first campaign mission, about 20 minutes of play. Free captured tanks, loot fuel and ammo from destroyed enemy trucks, and stop a supply column before it reaches the stranded enemy tanks. This mission has no base building. Your progress is saved at relay masts.

title: After Green Demo
description: Stack upgrades and forge relic-and-tower synergies as cute zombie hordes closing in. Dash, shoot and build defenses in this horde-survival roguelite as you choose your road to the Horde King, solo or in co-op. Fall, and your Last Wish powers the next run back to the floor that killed you!

title: Backrooms Anomaly: Pools Demo
description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in looping liminal poolrooms. Study your surroundings and identify changes ranging from subtle details to terrifying entities. Turn back if something has changed, continue if everything seems normal, and then use your camera to document the anomalies.

title: Volleyball Sports Game Demo
description: Run a volleyball club. Control every match. Build with Godot Engine, Volleyball Sports Game let you experience the life in Professional Volleyball.KEY FEATURESFull tactical control: set formations, rotations, and substitution patterns.Match engine: view each rally as it unfolds based on your tactics.

title: Programmable Theft Action VI Demo
description: Code the perfect crime — even with Vibe Coding.

title: Elite MMA Manager Demo
description: (This is the Demo version)Can you shape the careers of future MMA Legends? Start with nothing. Build a dynasty. Navigate the politics, egos, and brutal economics of professional MMA. Management game where you sign fighters as clients, and your job is to maximize their success.

title: Shield Operator Demo
description: Defend the skies against enemy missiles, drones, and aircraft! Deploy modern air defense systems, calculate trajectories, and destroy aerial targets in real time. Become an impenetrable shield for your territory. Repel any aerial threat with a decisive response!

title: Dillaball Demo
description: Shoot, roll, and break your way through the city in this fast-paced pinball-like arcade action game. Collect money to buy increasingly chaotic abilities to spice up your runs, call your friends and put on the headphones for some pop punk tunes and blast off!

title: MusicManiaz Demo
description: Play the drums in a rhythm game anyone can pick up, packed with lo-fi. (Over 20 lo-fi songs alone!) 50+ original tracks across all kinds of genres! Besides drums, play Melody and All Mix at three difficulties! Add your own favorite songs, auto-generate the chart, and play as much as you want!

title: MAR: Millions Are Rising Demo
description: Millions of monsters are escaping the hole. Stop them with a unique arsenal of towers, nukes, and deep upgrades in this incremental tower defense game.

title: 心镇图书馆 HeartLib Demo
description: As the new Librarian of Heart‑Lib, you wield the power of Books. Using the Mind‑Beacon as your anchor, deploy Illustrations, Pages and Reflections to repel the invaders of Heart‑Lib.

title: Everything In Its Place Demo
description: A cozy organizing game with a cold draft running through it. Sort, shelve and label the supplies of an abandoned shelter, and every corner you tidy pushes the dark back. Restore the lights, open the sublevels below, and turn somewhere unlivable into a home. Atmospheric horror. No jump scares.

title: What Happened to Emily Demo
description: Help Daniel uncover his lost memories and piece together the three days leading up to the murder of his wife, Emily.

title: Breakkaboom Demo
description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks, break stuff with them, and when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

title: Clear the Snow Demo
description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

title: Outliers: Incrementum Demo
description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters with a flick of your wrist, collect loot, and grow faster, stronger, and far more lethal with every run. Clear dungeon after dungeon until even their bosses become easy prey.

title: Echo of Memory - AI Profiler Demo
description: Echoe of Memory: AI Profiler is a near-future mystery detective adventure in which you reinvestigate cold cases from the past together with your AI partner, ECHO.You play as Makoto Kuroiwa, an investigator assigned to the Cold Case Investigation Support Office.

title: Egg to Monster Demo
description: Try the hatching and battle loop of Egg to Monster. Hatch five kinds of monsters from falling eggs, send them against enemy soldiers, collect berries and treasure, and strengthen your skills in this free demo.

title: Ascend to Immortal Throne - 问鼎仙台 Demo
description: "Ascend to Immortal Throne" is a cultivation RPG where you seek eternal life and ultimate power. Choose to walk the path of a lone cultivator, free and unrestrained in pursuit of the "Dao", or join a sect to cultivate alongside fellow disciples, uncover ancient inheritances, and fight in sect wars

title: Spook and Sell Demo
description: Spook & SellStage the haunt. Sell the house.You're the world's most desperate real-estate agents. The listing is haunted, the open house starts in minutes, and the buyers cannot find out. Hide every ghost, vacuum the ectoplasm, nail down the floating furniture — then smile through the tour before the haunting meter tips over.

title: Inbox Duel Demo
description: Email fight roguelike. Balatro is a hypnotically satisfying deckbuilder where you play illegal poker hands, discover game-changing jokers, and trigger adrenaline-pumping, outrageous combos.

title: Every Man for Himself and God Against All or, for a shorter name: TimeLeft Demo
Magic Kitchen Demo
description: A casual restaurant game about perfection, not pressure. Team up with a friend in local co-op, listen to your customers' demands, and master the perfect ingredient combinations on your way to a 5-star restaurant.

title: Gladiator Immortal Demo
description: Gladiator Immortal is a turn-based fantasy Medieval Gladiator Roguelike game where you manage a team of warriors who fight for the entertainment of the gods. Build up your town, hire and level up warriors, find powerful weapons and armour, learn and develop new skills and win favour with the gods

title: Gonzalo the Chicken Demo
description: This chicken is crossing the road... to blow up everything on the other side! Throw Gonzalo's loud-mouthed explosive sidekick Azzar at the Crocogator horde, and then use a magic glove to retrieve him. He holds on tight while you flutter through mountains and beaches and forests, oh my!

title: War.exe Demo
description: An incremental game where you click territories to gather intel, slowly increase your troops and resources, build a fleet of ships, unlock upgrades and new attacks, then launch invasions and conquer enemy territories.

title: Stick A Fork Demo
description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, smash the fruit into jam, Ascend, and watch the table get busier every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

title: Wizard School Dropout Demo
description: You left wizard school in disgrace, and now have only one option to pay off your student loans: crime. Wizard School Dropout is a magic-focused, turn-based RPG and wizard simulator featuring heavy environmental interactions and spell combinations for a wide variety of playstyles. Be Mage Do Crime!

title: BATHYSPHERE Demo
description: Searching for your missing sister, you arrive in Bermuda and descend into the deep in a bathysphere. Find the unseen enemy before it sinks you. Gather clues through endlessly repeating battles and close in on the truth behind the time loop.

title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure: Friends Pass
description: Join a friend in Hello Kitty Island Adventure for free! Restore a mysterious island, solve ancient puzzles, cook delicious dishes, customize yourself and your cabins, and so much more. Or play on your own in a special demo.

title: Serial Founder Demo
description: You have an idea and no company. The demo is the first act: type your idea, find someone to build it, make a first sale and get one VC fund into a room. A startup life sim where investors are people and failure is the punchline. Two of five beginnings, under an hour a run.

title: Roadside Burger Shack Demo
description: Get a taste of Roadside Burger Shack in this first-person cooking demo. Prep ingredients, grill patties, build burgers, manage your stock, and serve customers through a cozy roadside drive-thru.

title: Catadel: Slot Defense Demo
description: Play the first five weeks of Catadel: Slot Defense. Pull the lever, chain cascading matches with an army of cats, push your luck on the multiplier wheel for up to ×10 damage, and pay the royal tax on time. No real money, just risk and reward.

title: RAID VR Demo
description: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 2-player co-op action (4 players planned in full release).

title: Ashes of Animara Demo
description: Ashes of Animara is a top-down ship combat campaign. You are the last survivor of Animara. The Nihilus Order drained your world, and Lia, the atomic AI in your ship, is the only voice still with you. This is not a war. This is vengeance.This demo is the first strike.Create a pilot. Build one ship in the hangar and paint it your way.

title: Prevail Demo
description: A turn-based tactics roguelike on a hex board. Command a group of miniatures, outmaneuver enemies, and spend your gold between fights on weapons, gear and potions. Lose your party and the run is over. Every run is completely different than the last.

title: Today I... Demo
description: Try balancing your life, work, gender dysphoria, relationships, and a growingly time-consuming activist involvement in a queer association..

title: Souls of Bombarika Demo
description: Observe. Possess. Protect! Become a mischievous phantom, possess anything in your path, and manipulate an entire house to thwart an evil witch and three bomb-obsessed brothers in this supernatural puzzle adventure.

title: Behind Her Door Demo
description: After work, you visit your older sister’s house. The rooms feel wrong, familiar sounds carry through empty halls, and something may be watching from beyond the windows. Explore, uncover the truth, and survive the night.

title: Cook Knights Demo
description: Become a CookKnight! Explore a misterious dungeon, fight monsters and the evil undead forces of a necromancer, help people in need, pet a sheep and most importantly, cook amazing dishes to become stronger in this cute voxel action game.

title: Rasen Demo

description: Bloom Inc is a cozy incremental gardening game. Harvest plants, unlock skills and abilities. Explore different maps and grow your own plants in the background.

title: The Frog Prince: Unfrogged Demo

description: In a world where money is hard to come by, play as a cook of odd manners, and serve alien customers in your weird dinner. Prepare them nice and comforting meals… Or kill them, slice them and turn them into fresh meat to serve to your next order in line !
